title: Recruiter
description:
Our company is on a mission to redefine the way job seekers navigate their next career move. As a Reverse Recruiter, you will play a key role in this transformation, acting not just as a guide, but as a dedicated recruiter focused on helping our clients secure and land meaningful job opportunities.



In this role, you will partner closely with job seekers, taking the time to deeply understand their professional background, career goals, and personal preferences. You will then proactively identify, pursue, and match them with opportunities that align with their aspirations. Your work will directly impact their success by positioning them competitively in the job market and increasing their chances of getting hired.



Key Responsibilities:

• Build strong relationships with clients, serving as their recruiter, advisor, and advocate throughout their job search journey.

• Actively source and identify job opportunities that align with each client’s experience, skills, and career goals.

• Manage and maintain a consistent pipeline of relevant job postings tailored to each client.

• Evaluate job postings to ensure they meet client criteria and present strong placement potential.

• Support clients in the application process by guiding them on where and how to apply effectively.

• Serve as the main point of contact, providing ongoing support, updates, and strategic advice.

• Meet and exceed daily targets related to job sourcing and application activity.



Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred.

• Strong command of English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities.

• Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related tools.

• Proven ability to meet or exceed performance targets.

• At least 2 years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a results-driven environment and is passionate about helping people land jobs that align with their goals. As a Reverse Recruiter, your success is measured by your ability to connect clients with the right opportunities—and ultimately help them secure their next role.

Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.



Please submit examples of your own video editing work rather than AI-generated video content, as we're specifically looking to evaluate your editing skills, creative judgment, and ability to make raw footage engaging.



As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.

title: LinkedIn Growth Operator (Traffic-Focused | Performance-Based)
description:
About the Role



We operate a premium career infrastructure asset called the ABF Repository — a curated remote job and premium career product.



Current 30-day performance:

• 1,700+ views

• 22% CTR

• No active growth engine



We are installing a structured LinkedIn growth system.



Your mission:

Increase qualified traffic to the ABF Repository and strengthen authority positioning.



This role is performance-focused. We care about measurable traffic growth, not vanity engagement.



Responsibilities



• Write and publish 3–5 high-signal LinkedIn posts per week

• Create strong hooks for career-driven professionals

• Drive intentional clicks to the repository

• Execute targeted LinkedIn engagement strategy

• Monitor analytics and adjust strategy

• Provide a short monthly performance summary



KPIs (How You Win)



• Increase repository clicks month-over-month

• Grow total traffic

• Improve returning visitor rate

• Maintain or improve CTR



We measure outcomes, not activity.



Who This Is For



You:



• Understand LinkedIn growth mechanics

• Can write authority-driven content (not generic AI posts)

• Have grown a page, founder account, or brand before

• Think in systems and measurable strategy

• Are performance-oriented



If your focus is just “posting content,” this is not the role.



Compensation



Part-time (8–10 hours per week)



Base: $200–$250 (USD) per month



Performance bonuses tied to traffic milestones



Example bonus structure:



• + $100 at 2,500 monthly clicks

• + $200 at 4,000 clicks

• + $400 at 6,000+ clicks



Initial contract: 60 days

Extension and pay increases based on measurable growth.



This role is designed for operators who want upside.



To Apply



Please include:



A short (5–8 sentence) strategy explaining how you would 2–3x traffic in 90 days



2 examples of LinkedIn posts you’ve written



Any analytics screenshot showing measurable growth



Your expected monthly rate



Applications without measurable proof of results will not be considered.

Sales Operations Associate



Overview

We are seeking a meticulous and adaptable Sales Operations Associates to assist the Sales Account

process sales orders, procure and manage the orders, and provide customer service. The Sales Operations Associate is responsible for working closely with all areas of our organization to help

customers worldwide. Sales Operations Associates is a demanding role that is fast paced, requires

attention to detail, proactive behavior, and a professional demeanor. Focuses on building strong relationships with our customers, suppliers, and all internal teams and ensures our orders are processed accurately and timely.



To ensure success, Sales Operations Associates should have experience in a sales and/or customer

service environment, understand sales performance metrics, and excellent communication skills.



Responsibilities



? Support end-to-end sales activities and coordinate between Sales, Order Management, and Accounting Teams for all quote-to-order functions including:

? Creating sales quotes.

? Receiving and processing purchase orders.

? Entering and updating information in ERP.

? Verifying orders, including customers' contact information and payment details.

? Managing the orders from procurement to fulfillment

? Process upgrades, change orders, returns, refunds, order status inquiries, renewals, and discrepancy resolution.

? Act as a stakeholder in regards to orders, refunds, renewals, order status updates, all while interacting with customers via phone and
.

? Facilitate the supplier registration, purchase order setup, and account management

? Collaborate and communicate effectively with essential parties to drive efficient and accurate order processing, reporting, subscription renewals, and revenue recognition

? Partner with Finance to ensure order integrity to drive accurate billings and collections

? Advocate for customers’ needs by adapting complex processes, while also understanding downstream impacts

? Field incoming calls, chats, and
 requests

? Record customer communications and activities accurately and thoroughly in various internal systems, including Salesforce, Slack, and

? Contribute to ongoing process and workflow improvements

? Proactively builds trusting internal and external relationships. Can effectively communicate within all levels with the company, the customer, and vendor

? Support the sales department with other administrative tasks as needed.



Requirements

? At least 3 years experience in an administrative role supporting sales and/or customer service

? 1-2 years of order management experience

? Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word) and Google Suite applications

? Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred)

? Familiarity with sales reports and sales records.

? Exceptional interpersonal and customer service skills.

? Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Real Estate Appointment Setter – Warm Leads Only (Room to Grow)
description:
JOB TITLE

Remote Phone Rep, Land Seller Calls (Part-Time, Room to Grow)



TYPE OF WORK: Part-time

WAGE: $5/hour + $300 bonus per deal

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to start



JOB OVERVIEW



Ridgeline Land Solutions buys vacant land directly from owners all over the United States, and we're growing. We're looking for someone to grow with us.



This role starts at 4 hours a day, but it is not meant to stay that way. As you prove yourself on the phone, you'll be offered more hours and more responsibility, including taking on more of the deal process. We would much rather grow someone from inside the team than keep hiring new people. If you want a long-term role with a small business where your work is noticed and rewarded, this is it.



Our texting team finds landowners who say they're open to selling. You call them, learn about the land and why they might sell, and book them for an offer call with our team. You'll be the first real voice a seller hears from us, so how you sound on the phone matters more than anything else. You don't need years of sales experience. We will train you. We need someone who speaks clear English, shows up every day, and is easy to coach.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Call warm leads fast. When a landowner says yes to selling over text, you get them on the phone right away while they're still interested, then keep working down a ranked daily call list

- Follow a proven call script: confirm the property, ask about access, ownership and timeline, and find out why they might sell

- Get the seller's asking price, timeline and reason for selling on every call

- Book an offer call on our calendar before you hang up

- Follow a set callback schedule for sellers who don't answer: voi
, a text, and a call again on set days

- Log every call in our CRM and post a short call summary in Slack



At the start, you won't make offers or talk numbers. Our team handles every price conversation. Your job is to learn about the land and the seller and get the offer call booked.



SCHEDULE, PAY AND GROWTH



- Starting hours: 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday (20 hours a week)

- Base pay: $5 per hour

- Deal bonus: $300 for every property we buy from a seller you spoke with on the first call (paid once the land is in our name, for deals that go under contract within 90 days of your call)

- Paid weekly, every Friday

- Independent contractor, fully remote



Room to grow: the bonus means your income goes up as you get better at your job, and strong performers will be offered more hours and a bigger role in the business over time. We want this to be a long-term position for the right person.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent. Many of our sellers are older, rural Americans, so they need to understand you easily on the phone

- Reliable. You show up on time every shift and communicate if something comes up

- Coachable. You take feedback on your calls and improve quickly

- Friendly and confident asking direct questions about price, timeline and reasons for selling

- Able to listen, let people talk, and politely steer back to the questions

- A quiet place to work, a good headset and reliable internet

- Available 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern every weekday

- Looking for a long-term role, not a short side gig



Nice to have:

- Outbound calling, appointment setting or sales experience

- Experience with real estate or land sellers

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack or a similar CRM

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude

- You've worked with US clients before



HOW TO APPLY



We only review applications that include a voice recording. Start your application with the words "gravel road" so we know you read this far.



Send:

1. Your resume or a short summary of your work experience

2. A link to a 1 minute voice recording introducing yourself. Just talk to us naturally, no script. Tell us who you are and about any work you've done on the phone or with customers. Record it on Vocaroo or upload it to Google Drive, and make sure anyone with the link can listen.

3. Confirm you can work 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday, starting next week.



We'll invite the strongest applicants to book a short live interview. If you're looking for a long-term role where you can grow, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Administratvie Assistant (Remote)
description:
** NOT AN ACCOUNTING POSITION



POSITION OVERVIEW



Join the Techvestor team as a key part of our finance department. You'll be responsible for ensuring our financial operations run smoothly, from maintaining records and checking to make sure tax, insurance and mortgage payments are made to provide info about our assets to our investors. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring our properties are managed efficiently and our investors are kept informed. 



● Saving property documents and pictures to the correct folders in Dropbox 

● Uploading photos and maintaining info for property pages on our investor portal 

● Sending documents/contracts and inputting data into Google Sheets 

● Setting up properties for sales/occupancy taxes with Avalara and uploading monthly property revenue reports

● Calling about account concerns, discrepancies in billing, and other concerns 

● Assistance with record maintenance 

● Coordinating with Ops with license-related topics



SAVING PROPERTY DOCUMENTS AND PICTURES TO THE CORRECT IN DROPBOX

● We have very important files that come in before, during, and after we close on a property. Part of this job will be to save these files to the correct folders in Dropbox so that our team can access them later. 

● Photos need to be saved from each of our properties’ 
 webpages before we close on the property. There will also be progress photos and photos of the finished properties once we launch them as short-term rentals that will need to be saved as well. 



UPLOADING PHOTOS AND MAINTAINING INFO FOR PROPERTY PAGES ON OUR INVESTOR PORTAL 

● We have an investor portal through InvestNext we maintain for our investors. Part of this job’s responsibilities will be to maintain the “Assets” section of the portal. This section should be kept up to date with relevant progress photos, summaries, high-level info, and links to the Airbnb listing for each property. 



SENDING DOCUMENTS/CONTRACT AND INPUTTING DATA INTO GOOGLE SHEETS BASED ON RESPONSES

● We have contracts, licenses, and documents for our properties that need to be saved and properly tracked on our end. It is extremely important that this information is accurate, up to date and recorded.

● It is extremely important that this information is entered correctly as we depend on it to report and file our taxes and make sure that our rentals are able to run operations smoothly.



SETTING UP PROPERTIES FOR SALES/OCCUPANCY TAXES WITH AVALAR AND UPLOADING MONTHLY PROPERTY REVENUE REPORTS

● Before each of our properties goes live as a short-term rental, we need to sign it up with Avalara’s Lodge Tax division so they can report our revenue numbers on a monthly basis and make sure any taxes not remitted directly by Airbnb/VRBO are paid. 

● Monthly revenue reports that show taxes already remitted from each of our properties need to be uploaded to Avalara’s website each month so they can file taxes on our behalf accordingly. 

● When setting up new properties on Avalara’s website, we may be required to register our business in new states in order to file taxes. This position would be expected to assist in registering the business in new states when applicable. 



MORTGAGE AND INSURANCE MAINTENANCE AND UPDATE

● Ensures that Mortgage and Insurance are updated, renewed, and tracked.

● On occasion, a mortgage payment and/or insurance payment may have been made, but not credited to our account. You will be tasked with calling the appropriate vendor and resolving the issue at hand.



ASSISTANCE WITH RECORD MAINTENANCE

● Needs to be able to call vendors and get necessary information to keep business records up to date.

title: Senior Airbnb Operations and Maintenence Manager/Supervisor
description:
Hello!



We’re seeking an experienced Senior Airbnb Operations Manager/Supervisor to run our short-term rental operation. In addition to handling the guests, the candidate should have a lot of experience managing maintenance and cleaning. The role starts part-time and may grow into full-time. This is NOT entry-level, and supervision experience is required.



We have five high-end rentals in North Carolina and California. Our guests expect exceptional service, fast communication and quick resolution.



You’ll manage the whole operation. That means finding and hiring good cleaners, handymen, HVAC professionals, plumbers, etc., supervising them, and understanding what’s actually wrong when a house has a problem: who to send, what it should cost, and whether the repair was done right. You own issues from start to finish without constant supervision, and you have a phone-always-on, ownership mentality.



Responsibilities



Find, vet, hire and manage cleaners (Turno), handymen and maintenance vendors, and check their work

Diagnose maintenance issues, get quotes, and follow up until fixed and verified

Spot problems early with preventive maintenance

Guest communication and reservations in Hostaway

Task tracking in Asana, team updates in Slack, and clear documentation

Airbnb Resolution Center cases, damage claims, escalations and review removals

Turning our Assistant Handbook into SOPs, and using AI to make operations run smoother



Requirements



Experience hiring and managing cleaners and maintenance vendors

Working knowledge of home maintenance and repairs

Management/supervision experience

Significant Airbnb operations experience, including Resolution Center cases, claims and escalations

Extensive Hostaway experience

Experience with Asana or similar

Excellent written English and communication

Experience and interest in AI

Evening and weekend availability

Airbnb Tier 2 / Senior Support / Trust & Safety experience strongly preferred



To Apply



Answer in your own words, without AI, with as much detail as you can. All answers will be analyzed for AI use.



1. Describe your short-term rental operations management/supervisor experience. Include your years in STR, how many of those you supervised others, and how many cleaners and vendors you managed.



2. Your level of experience with Hostaway.



3. What’s the most complex maintenance or cleaning problem you handled start to finish? What was wrong with the house, how you diagnosed it from afar, who you sent, what it cost, what went wrong along the way, and how it ended. Please use SPECIFIC examples 



4. How do you find and vet a good handyman or other service professional? Tell me about one who turned out to be bad and what you did.



5. Availability: for training, are you free mornings EST? For part-time, 4pm-7pm EST? For full-time, 3pm-12am EST? Do you understand this is part-time with potential to become full-time?

Please begin your application with:



“I am an experienced Airbnb operations manager with experience supervising others.”



Applications that don’t follow these instructions will not be considered.



Thank you!

title: Unity Developer I
description:
We’re looking for a Unity Developer to help build and maintain games and interactive experiences. You’ll work across the Unity stack with a primary focus on C# and systems code—gameplay logic, tools, integrations, performance, and pipelines. Genres and projects shift with what the team is building (RPG, tactical, casual, prototypes, and more); solid engineering matters more than specializing in one genre.



Schedule & flexibility



Core collaboration time: 9:00 AM PHT — standups, reviews, and live coordination usually happen in this window.

Flexible arrangement — we focus on outcomes and clear communication; outside that window, hours can flex to fit your workflow as long as deliverables and team sync stay on track.

Responsibilities



Game development — Implement and refine gameplay systems, mechanics, interactions, and editor workflows in Unity.

Scripting & programming — Write clean, maintainable C# for game logic, tools, AI, UI controllers, and third-party integrations.

Optimization & performance — Profile and improve CPU/GPU, memory, loading, physics, and rendering for target platforms.

Collaboration — Work with designers, artists, QA, and other engineers on features, pipelines, and iteration.

Debugging & quality — Find and fix bugs, improve stability, and tighten the player experience.

Requirements



Unity & C# — Hands-on Unity development with solid C#.

Systems & gameplay code — Comfortable with mechanics, UI wiring, data-driven design, and reusable architecture.

Problem-solving — Strong debugging, profiling, and performance troubleshooting.

Team collaboration — Experience in a multi-discipline game or interactive product team.

Version control — Comfortable with Git (or similar) and sensible branching/review habits.

Bonus skills



Multiplayer / networking (e.g. Netcode, Mirror, Photon, custom solutions).

AI, pathfinding, or behavior systems.

Procedural content, addressables/content pipeline, or build automation.

Shaders (Shader Graph / HLSL) or render pipeline work (Built-in, URP, HDRP).

Native plugins, platform SDKs, or console/mobile shipping experience.

Animation — Timeline, Animator state machines, blending, root motion, or wiring animation to gameplay code.

UI — uGUI / UI Toolkit, responsive layouts, HUD/menus, data binding, and performant in-game interfaces.



What we offer



Varied Unity work across whatever genres and projects the team is shipping, with a code-first focus and room to grow into architecture, tools, and specialized areas.

Flexible hours anchored on 9:00 AM PHT for team overlap.

A collaborative environment where engineering quality and player experience both matter.



If you enjoy solving technical problems in Unity and want room to work on different kinds of projects, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Finance & NetSuite Specialist – Full-Time Remote

Opportunities for professional growth and performance-based pay increases



We are hiring an experienced Finance & NetSuite Specialist to support a U.S.-based company in the health and wellness industry. We’re looking for someone with in-depth NetSuite knowledge, strong accounting and finance skills, and practical payroll experience.



You’ll play a hands-on role in implementing NetSuite, helping translate the company’s finance and payroll needs into clear system requirements and reliable workflows. You’ll also support day-to-day financial operations as the business transitions to the system.



This role requires someone who already knows NetSuite very well and has helped implement it before. You should be comfortable guiding a team through unfamiliar decisions, recommending practical solutions, and taking ownership of your work.



Key Responsibilities:



Work with company leadership and implementation partners to understand finance and payroll requirements and translate them into NetSuite workflows



Take ownership of assigned implementation tasks, including supporting system setup, data preparation, testing, and launch



Recommend practical approaches to NetSuite processes and explain options clearly to colleagues who are less familiar with the system



Clean, organize, and validate financial data for migration, ensuring records and opening balances reconcile



Test accounting workflows and reports, document issues, and follow through on resolutions



Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, journal entries, and general ledger maintenance



Complete bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations; investigate and resolve discrepancies



Support month-end close and prepare financial reports and supporting schedules



Prepare or review payroll inputs, follow up on discrepancies, and reconcile payroll-related transactions to the general ledger



Create and maintain NetSuite saved searches, reports, and dashboards



Troubleshoot NetSuite transaction and workflow issues, coordinating with implementation partners when needed



Document procedures and help colleagues use NetSuite effectively



Provide clear progress updates, flag obstacles early, and keep implementation tasks moving



Protect confidential financial, company, and employee information



Required Qualifications:



At least three years of relevant accounting or finance operations experience, including reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close



Advanced, hands-on NetSuite proficiency, with substantial experience using its core accounting and finance functions



Direct involvement in at least one NetSuite implementation or migration, with meaningful responsibility for requirements, system setup, data preparation, validation, testing, or launch support



Ability to explain your personal contribution to a previous NetSuite implementation and the problems you helped resolve



Ability to work independently in NetSuite, investigate transaction discrepancies, troubleshoot workflow issues, and produce accurate reports



Strong working knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, financial reporting, CSV imports, and dashboards



Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, the general ledger, and financial statements



Practical payroll experience, including reviewing payroll information, resolving discrepancies, and reconciling payroll entries



Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling information across multiple files or reports



Excellent written and spoken English



Ability to explain financial and system issues clearly, recommend solutions, and communicate confidently with a U.S.-based team



Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through



Ability to manage recurring finance deadlines alongside implementation tasks



Reliable internet and a quiet, private workspace



Availability to work the full U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed below



Applicants must bring established NetSuite expertise and hands-on implementation experience. Experience limited to basic data entry or viewing reports is not sufficient for this role.



Preferred Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field



Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses



Experience configuring NetSuite finance workflows and supporting user acceptance testing



Experience reconciling financial information between a previous accounting system and NetSuite



Familiarity with U.S. payroll processes and payroll platforms



Experience documenting financial procedures and training colleagues



Relevant accounting qualification or NetSuite certification



Work Setup:



Full-time, permanent remote position; Philippines-based candidates only



Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



Eight working hours per day, with one hour of breaks throughout the day; 40 working hours per week



Schedule follows U.S. Eastern Time, including daylight saving changes



Target start date within two weeks



All confidential financial and employee information must remain within approved company systems



Who We’re Looking For:



Someone who knows NetSuite well and brings equally strong finance skills. You understand how transactions flow through the accounts, can recognize when a balance is incorrect, and know how to investigate and resolve the issue.



You’ve helped a business implement NetSuite and can explain what worked, what needed attention, and how you contributed. You’re comfortable guiding colleagues, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into practical processes.



You take ownership, communicate early, and follow through without repeated reminders. We’re looking for a dependable professional who can become a trusted, long-term member of the team.



How to Apply:



Please send your résumé and a brief introduction answering the following:



How long have you used NetSuite, and which accounting and finance functions have you personally handled?



Describe a NetSuite implementation or migration you supported. What were you personally responsible for?



Share one implementation or NetSuite workflow issue you helped resolve and explain how you approached it.



What experience do you have with reconciliations, month-end close, financial reporting, and payroll?



Give an example of a NetSuite report, saved search, or import you created or managed.



What is your earliest available start date, and can you work the listed schedule?



Please ensure your résumé clearly shows your NetSuite implementation experience and the finance and payroll responsibilities you have personally handled.



SKILL REQUIREMENT



NetSuite | NetSuite Implementation | Accounting & Finance | Payroll | Microsoft Excel

You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. (HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.

Required

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

*Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?



*Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

*Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

*Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

title: Chief Operating Officer/Client Success Manager
description:
# Chief Operating Officer — Online Business



**Company:** Resell Signals / SellPilot

**Position:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Compensation:** Base salary plus performance incentives. $50k to $120k OTE



## About the Position



We are hiring an experienced, hands-on Chief Operating Officer to take ownership of the daily operations of our growing e-commerce education and software company.



**This is not a beginner position.**



Our company is already generating more than **$1 million per year**, and we need someone who has previously managed the operations, fulfillment, client success, and staff of an established online business.



We are not looking for someone who wants to learn how to operate a company. We need someone who has already done it successfully and can step in, identify problems, manage the team, improve systems, and help us scale.



You will be responsible for making sure the company runs properly every day, clients are supported and getting results, staff members are performing, and fulfillment is being completed at a high standard.



## Key Responsibilities



### Operations and Fulfillment



* Take ownership of all daily company operations.

* Oversee client fulfillment, customer support, client success, and service delivery.

* Make sure every client receives what they were promised.

* Monitor client satisfaction, results, retention, refunds, cancellations, and chargebacks.

* Identify operational problems and resolve them without waiting for the founder.

* Create and improve SOPs, workflows, quality-control processes, and reporting systems.

* Ensure the business can operate smoothly without constant founder involvement.

* Provide weekly reports covering client results, team performance, problems, and priorities.



### Team Management and Hiring



* Manage fulfillment, support, client success, and operational staff.

* Set clear expectations, deadlines, responsibilities, and performance metrics.

* Hold staff accountable and address underperformance quickly.

* Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and train new tea
mbers.

* Build strong department leaders who can manage their responsibilities independently.

* Ensure communication between sales, fulfillment, support, and marketing remains organized.



### Client Success



* Improve client onboarding, communication, support, and overall experience.

* Make sure clients are progressing and receiving measurable value.

* Identify inactive, confused, unhappy, or at-risk clients before they cancel.

* Resolve serious client problems professionally and quickly.

* Create systems that improve client results, retention, and satisfaction.

* Collect feedback, testimonials, case studies, and success stories.

* Make sure the sales team does not promise anything the fulfillment team cannot deliver.



### Systems and Growth



* Improve the company’s programs, software, services, and internal processes.

* Turn the founder’s ideas into organized projects, deadlines, and completed outcomes.

* Find opportunities to automate, delegate, or simplify repetitive work.

* Manage GoHighLevel, CRM automations, project management tools, and reporting dashboards.

* Identify new services, upsells, recurring revenue opportunities, and offer improvements.

* Monitor staffing requirements, fulfillment capacity, operational expenses, and profit margins.

* Prepare the company to handle more clients without lowering service quality.



### Content and Marketing



* Record one long-form YouTube video each week.

* Record short-form videos for Instagram and other social media platforms.

* Work with the marketing team on content, messaging, promotions, and campaigns.

* Help improve the company’s social media presence and positioning.

* Represent the company professionally and confidently on camera.



## Required Experience



Applicants should have proven experience:



* Managing operations for an established e-commerce, SaaS, coaching, education, or online service business.

* Overseeing client success, customer support, and fulfillment departments.

* Managing remote employees, contractors, and department leaders.

* Hiring, training, evaluating, and replacing staff when necessary.

* Creating SOPs, dashboards, quality-control systems, and performance scorecards.

* Managing a business with meaningful revenue, client volume, and operational complexity.

* Improving client retention, fulfillment performance, and team accountability.

* Making important decisions without constant founder approval.



## Preferred Experience



* E-commerce or online business operations

* High-ticket programs, coaching, digital education, or SaaS

* GoHighLevel and CRM automation

* Social media marketing and online advertising

* Sales funnels and digital products

* Client success and retention management

* Content creation and on-camera communication



## Who This Position Is Not For



This position is not suitable for someone who:



* Has only managed a small team or early-stage project.

* Is looking for their first operations leadership position.

* Requires constant instructions or supervision.

* Avoids difficult conversations with employees or clients.

* Has never managed fulfillment or client success.

* Only has theoretical knowledge of online business.

* Is uncomfortable being held accountable for company-wide results.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, you should be able to:



* Fully understand the company’s departments, offers, and fulfillment systems.

* Take daily operational responsibilities away from the founder.

* Establish clear performance metrics for every department.

* Improve client onboarding, support, results, and retention.

* Strengthen team accountability and communication.

* Identify staffing gaps and recruit stronger tea
mbers.

* Improve SOPs, reporting, automation, and quality control.

* Present a clear plan for scaling the company beyond its current revenue level.



## How to Apply



We are every single applications but Please submit:



* Your resume and a short introduction.

* The names and types of online businesses you have helped operate.

* The highest annual revenue level of a business whose operations you managed.

* The number of employees or contractors you directly managed.

* Your experience overseeing fulfillment and client success.

* Your experience using GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

* A short video explaining why you are qualified for this position. If no intro video, your application will be ignored

* Your desired compensation and availability.



Include the phrase and password **“I will scale your company”** in your application so we know you reviewed the full posting.

ABOUT THE ROLE



I am seeking a highly capable Real Estate Operations Manager / Executive Assistant to manage the moving pieces across 17 rental units, ongoing renovations, contractors, tenants, and emerging business opportunities. I do not need a high-level "business strategist" or a generic data-entry virtual assistant; I need a relentless executor with analytical skills. You will act as a "second brain" for tracking and a "right hand" for execution.



ROLE BREAKDOWN

• 25% Executive Support: Managing inbox, calendar, priorities, meeting prep, and personal scheduling.



• 15% Analysis & Systems: Maintaining spreadsheets, property reporting, drafting SOPs, comparing costs, and improving processes.

• Administration: Organize invoices, receipts, contracts, and closing documents. Manage the executive inbox, calendar, and task list.



• System Building: Create repeatable systems for maintenance, turnovers, renovations, and purchasing. Turn ideas into assigned actions with owners and deadlines.



REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience: Proven experience in U.S. property management, construction coordination, or as a real estate assistant. Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.



• Communication: Excellent spoken English; comfortable and confident making calls to tenants, contractors, attorneys, and lenders.



• Technical Skills: Strong Google Sheets skills with basic financial reasoning. Comfortable using Notion, Google Workspace, property-management software, and AI tools.



• Disposition: Assertive and persistent with vendors. Calm under pressure when information is incomplete or people are unresponsive. Independent problem-solver.

• Candidates looking for standard data-entry or social-media roles.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Overview

MOD BIKES is looking for a highly skilled Senior Video Editor to join our team full-time. We’re searching for someone who understands how to create content that not only looks great, but also performs.



This role is heavily focused on editing high-converting ads, cinematic product videos, TikToks/Reels, YouTube content, and brand storytelling pieces that help drive engagement and sales. We need someone with strong creative instincts, excellent pacing and storytelling ability, and a deep understanding of modern content trends across social media and e-commerce.

You should be comfortable taking a project from raw footage to polished final deliverable with minimal oversight while maintaining a high creative standard and strong attention to detail.



Experience with CapCut is required, though advanced experience in equivalent professional editing platforms is also highly valued.



If you also have strong photo editing skills - including studio retouching, lifestyle image editing, color correction, and e-commerce image preparation - that is a major plus.



We’re looking for a long-term creative partner who can help shape the visual identity and storytelling direction of MOD BIKES.



Key Responsibilities

1. Edit high-quality short-form and long-form content for:

- Paid ads

- TikTok/Reels

- YouTube

- Product overview videos

- Brand storytelling content

2. Create edits that align with MOD BIKES’ brand identity, marketing goals, and performance objectives.

3. Collaborate closely with the marketing and creative team to develop and refine content concepts.

4. Contribute creative input on pacing, hooks, storytelling structure, music selection, transitions, and overall video strategy.

5. Organize footage, project files, and creative assets efficiently across multiple ongoing projects.

6. Deliver polished content on schedule while maintaining high production quality and consistency.

7. Stay current on editing trends, platform trends, and high-performing content styles across social media and D2C brands.

8. (Bonus) Support photo editing workflows including:

- Retouching

- Color correction

- White background removal

- Lifestyle photo enhancements

- E-commerce image preparation



Key Requirements

1. Advanced to expert-level video editing skills in CapCut or equivalent professional editing software.

2. Strong understanding of performance-driven content and marketing-focused storytelling.

3. Proven experience editing for D2C, e-commerce, lifestyle, or consumer brands.

4. Strong sense of pacing, composition, sound design, and emotional storytelling.

5. Ability to independently manage projects from concept to final delivery.

6. Excellent creative judgment and attention to detail.

7. Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken).

8. Must be available for real-time collaboration and video meetings during Central Time (CT) business hours.

9. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple fast-moving projects simultaneously.



Nice-to-Have Skills (Not Required)

Photo editing experience (studio and lifestyle photography).

Motion graphics or graphic design experience.

Experience creating high-performing social media ads.

Familiarity with YouTube editing and retention-focused storytelling.

Experience working with automotive, cycling, outdoor, lifestyle, or adventure brands.



To Apply

Please include the following in your application:

- A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

- A portfolio or links to recent work.

- Examples of content you’ve edited that you believe performed particularly well.

- Your preferred editing software and workflow.

- Your availability and current location/time zone.



We care far more about quality, creativity, and storytelling ability than formal credentials. If your work stands out, we want to see it.

***********************************

QUALIFICATIONS

- Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or corporate account acquisition.

- Hands-on experience with cold calling, outbound prospecting, and lead generation.

- Demonstrated ability to personally negotiate and close sales.

- Experience managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing and account development.

- Strong spoken and written English, with confidence communicating with US-based business decision-makers.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of sales targets, and develop opportunities without constant supervision.

- Strong follow-up, negotiation, relationship-building, and pipeline management skills.

- Experience in US corporate gifting, promotional products, branded merchandise, or corporate merchandise.

- Experience selling to US companies, distributors, HR departments, marketing teams, or procurement departments.

- Familiarity with corporate purchasing processes, bulk orders, and customized products.

- Experience using industry platforms such as SAGE, ESP, or commonSKU.



**We welcome experienced B2B sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate a strong track record of personally generating and closing deals.**



***********************************

COMPENSATION & GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



- Base salary: US$1,500 per month + commission.

- Commission arrangements are negotiable based on experience.

- Opportunity to take ownership of a growing US sales channel.

- Direct contribution to the company's sales strategy, client acquisition, and revenue growth.



***********************************

HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Link to your CV/Resume: Include your relevant sales and business development experience.

2. Link to you Portfolio or Sales Track Record: Share examples of deals, accounts, or business opportunities you have personally generated and closed.

3. Link to your Sales Results Summary: Provide 2–3 bullet points highlighting your sales achievements. Include the industry, period covered, approximate deal values or results, and your individual contribution. Experience in corporate gifting is welcome, but B2B sales results from other industries are also accepted.

4. REQUIRED Recorded Video Introduction: Submit a 5–8 minute Loom video or similar recording covering:

- Your approach to cold calling and handling rejection or stalled opportunities.

- How you manage your sales pipeline and follow-ups.

Please anonymize clients and protect confidential information. We are interested in your actual sales experience, ownership, and approach—not polished video production.



Also indicate your availability and ability to work with US business hours.



***********************************



If you can open doors, build business relationships, turn prospects into customers, and consistently close deals, we would like to hear from you!

title: Client Account Manager – Accounting & Advisory (AI-Augmented US Firm)
description:
💰 Compensation Structure & Multi-Level Earning Potential

Compensation is paid monthly via fixed, predictable retainers per assigned client ledger. We do not pay by the hour; we reward efficiency, data integrity, and tech-forward automation.

Our firm features a structured, 5-Tier Compensation Framework. You will begin with our active Level 1 and Level 2 accounts. As the firm scales and you prove your mastery of our workflows, you have the direct potential to be assigned to higher-paying, complex portfolios:



• Level 1 — $50 USD per client/month (Micro-Accounts)

Low-volume, straightforward bookkeeping with limited active accounts, low transaction volume, and minimal reconciliation complexity.

	• Benchmark: Simple Short-term rental / Airbnb-type engagement.



• Level 2 — $100 USD per client/month (Standard Business Accounts)

Moderate recurring bookkeeping workload. Features multiple active accounts, active credit cards/merchant processors, Profit First allocation accounts, light payroll-related bookkeeping, and moderate Balance Sheet activity.

	• Benchmarks: Standard local service provider, beauty/wellness business, or accounting/tax firm internal books.



• Level 3 — $175 USD per client/month (Advanced Business Accounts)

Materially higher recurring bookkeeping workload. Features numerous active accounts, higher transaction volume, meaningful payroll-related bookkeeping, multiple owners/shareholders, active A/R or A/P, and greater reconciliation/close requirements.

	• Benchmark: Construction, commercial property management, or mid-sized service providers with substantial operational accounting complexity.



• Level 4 — $250 USD per client/month (High-Volume / Multi-Entity Portfolios)

Highly complex bookkeeping involving multiple businesses or entities within a single client relationship. Features separate books across separate entities, high aggregate transaction volume, intercompany transfers, significant fixed assets, and extensive Month-End, Quarter-End, and Year-End requirements.

	• Benchmark: Multi-business, multi-entity client relationships generating $450,000–$500,000+ in revenue requiring collective bookkeeping across separate business entities (e.g., a single owner running a handyman service, a roofing company, and a holding group simultaneously).



• Level 5 — $350 – $500 USD per client/month (Premium / Advisory-Integrated Portfolio)

Premium engagement involving substantial bookkeeping complexity PLUS specifically authorized, expanded financial-analysis, financial-management recommendations, independent professional judgment, and client-facing financial-review responsibilities.

	• Requirement: Requires specific PFT authorization and demonstrated competency. Actual compensation within the $350–$500 range depends entirely upon the actual assigned scope.



About Our Firm

Profit First Taxes is a modern, high-efficiency United States-based tax and accounting firm led by an Enrolled Agent (EA). We operate primarily on US Eastern Time. Our firm leverages cutting-edge technology and QuickBooks AI to eliminate 80% of traditional manual data entry.

We serve a stable, highly automated portfolio of clients, including real estate/Airbnb investors, e-commerce brands, and local businesses, alongside our own corporate books. We do not hire traditional data-entry clerks who simply want to click buttons. We hire articulate, analytical, and autonomous Account Managers who act as the pilots of our automation, protect our data hygiene, and help deliver high-level financial insights to our clients.



Position Overview

You will manage a select portfolio of US-based business accounts under the direct mentorship of an Enrolled Agent. Because our software handles the routine data matching, your value lies in your critical thinking, data auditing, and professional communication. You must be completely comfortable working independently, taking initiative when the firm owner is unavailable, and communicating directly with clients.



Core Responsibilities & Strict Deadlines

• Supervise the Automation: Review and approve automated QuickBooks AI transaction classifications weekly. Proactively maintain tight bank rules to keep matching accuracy above 85%.

• Reconciliations & Diagnostics: Perform complete month-end reconciliations for bank accounts, credit cards, and specialized e-commerce/merchant platforms.

• The 10th-of-the-Month Closeout Rule: All assigned accounts must be fully closed and reconciled within 10 days of month-end. You are required to submit a mandatory 5-to-10 minute screen-share video (using Loom) by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the 10th of every month showing successful reconciliation screens.

• The 14th Correction Deadline: PFT reviews all submissions between the 11th and 13th. All corrections must be fully completed and resubmitted by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the 14th to satisfy the completion standard for that month's compensation cycle.

• AI-Driven Advisory Prep: Extract quarterly financial statements, leverage advanced LLMs (ChatGPT or Gemini) to investigate variances, and refine the output into a professional executive summary.

• Direct Client Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for your assigned accounts. Independently schedule short appointments with clients via the firm's calendar to go over their monthly or quarterly books and answer questions.



Mandatory Performance & Contract Terms

1. Flat-Rate, All-Inclusive Structure: The monthly flat retainer per account is fully inclusive of all operational tasks, including transaction checking, reconciliations, client scheduling, async Loom video updates, and necessary internal review meetings. No additional hourly billing or meeting fees are permitted.

2. Review-Ready Standard: Marking an account as "Review-Ready" means all bank rules are verified, miscellaneous/suspense accounts are completely cleared, and the ledger is ready for the EA's final sign-off without routine cleanup.

3. No Automatic Tenure Increases: Length of service does not grant automatic raises. Compensation scaling is strictly tied to your willingness to assume advanced advisory tasks (like budgeting) and your demonstrated accuracy.



Required Qualifications

• Tax & Accounting Firm Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of direct experience working inside a US-based CPA firm, tax firm, or accounting practice. You must thoroughly understand the connection between daily bookkeeping entries and clean, tax-ready financial statements.

• E-Commerce & Real Estate Fluency: Proven experience managing books for US small businesses, S-Corps, real estate/Airbnb operations, Service based businesses and Shopify environments.

• Degree in Accounting: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is strictly required.

• Tech-Forward Mindset: Highly proficient with QuickBooks Online, advanced bank rules, and utilizing ChatGPT or Gemini for financial analysis documentation.

• Excellent Spoken English: Completely confident and articulate when speaking directly with US business owners over video calls.

• BIG PLUS – Tax Preparation Experience: Candidates who have verified experience preparing US federal tax returns (Form 1040, 1120S, or 1065) will be heavily prioritized. While this is primarily an Account Manager position, an opportunity exists for a high-paying dual role where you can take on separate tax preparation workloads during the busy US tax season.



⚠️ MANDATORY APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, you must reply with the exact subject line: "Ready to Pilot the Automation for PFT".

Your application message must include a link or file for a 3-to-5 minute screen-share video recording addressing the two practical scenarios below.

Note: You are entirely free to use any video recording software or sharing platform of your choice (Loom, Zoom recording, Vidyard, an unlisted YouTube video, or a cloud drive link like Google Drive/Dropbox). Loom is welcome but not mandatory. You do not need—and should not use—a live QuickBooks account for this demonstration. You are entirely free to use any creative presentation method you prefer (such as opening a blank spreadsheet, typing into a notepad document, or prompting live inside ChatGPT/Gemini on screen) to verbally explain and demonstrate your problem-solving process. We want to see how you process information, think critically, and communicate financial concepts on your feet.



Scenario A: The Shopify Payout Discrepancy

• The Situation: A client’s bank feed shows a clean net deposit from Shopify for $4,500. However, the Shopify store backend shows that gross sales for that exact period were actually $5,000, with $300 in merchant fees and $200 in sales tax collected.



• Your Task: Share your screen and verbally walk us through the step-by-step accounting logic of how you would handle and process this situation so the final business financials remain 100% tax-ready and accurate.



Scenario B: The AI Financial Analysis

• The Situation: A client’s Profit & Loss statement shows that "Advertising Expenses" suddenly spiked from $1,200 last month to $4,800 this month, while their gross revenue only increased by 5%.



• Your Task: Share your screen and demonstrate or explain how you would leverage an advanced Large Language Model (like ChatGPT or Gemini) to investigate this variance and prepare a concise, high-level, 3-bullet-point executive summary for the firm owner.



Applications that fail to use the correct subject line or fail to provide the open-ended Loom video link will be automatically archived without review.

title: Operations Manager – Short-Term Rental / Airbnb Property Management
description:
# We're Hiring: Operations Manager – Airbnb & Short-Term Rental Management

Remote | Full-Time**



### About Us



Justhost is a growing property management and concierge company specializing in short-term rentals and Airbnb properties around Disneyland Paris.



We manage the entire guest experience and property operations, from guest communication and reservations to cleaning, maintenance, pricing and owner relations.

This is a key leadership position. You will work closely with the company owner initially, with the objective of taking over the day-to-day management of the business and ensuring everything runs smoothly without constant supervision.



### Your Responsibilities



**1. Operations Management**

- Handle operational issues, emergencies and guest complaints.

- Make quick decisions and find solutions when problems arise.

- Conduct regular team meetings and provide feedback.

- Ensure cleaning standards are consistently met.

- Organize inspections and quality checks.

- Handle last-minute cleaning, maintenance and property-related issues.

- Build strong relationships with reliable local contractors.



**4. Guest Experience & Performance**

- Monitor Airbnb and 
 reviews and overall guest satisfaction.

- Ensure excellent response times and professional communication.

- Identify recurring problems and implement corrective actions.

- Maintain and improve our overall guest ratings and property performance.

- Take ownership of guest complaints and ensure they are resolved efficiently.



**5. Partnerships & Business Development**

- Identify and establish partnerships with local businesses and service providers.

- Develop partnerships that allow Justhost to offer additional services to guests and property owners.

- Negotiate partnership agreements and maintain relationships.

- Identify opportunities to improve our service offering and generate additional revenue.



**6. Recruitment & Process Improvement**

- Identify staffing needs and recruit new VAs, cleaners and maintenance providers.

- Create and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Implement systems to improve efficiency and accountability.

- Monitor operational KPIs and report regularly to the owner.



### Requirements – Experience Is Essential



We are looking for someone who already has solid experience in operations management, ideally within Airbnb, short-term rentals, hospitality or property management.



**You must have:**

- At least 3 years of relevant professional experience.

- Previous experience managing a team, ideally remote teams.

- Strong knowledge of Airbnb and short-term rental operations.

- Experience handling guest complaints and operational emergencies.

- Experience coordinating cleaning and maintenance teams.

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Airbnb and

Experience with Hostaway is a strong advantage.

We need a strong, hands-on manager who:

- Takes initiative and anticipates problems before they happen.

- Is comfortable making decisions independently.

- Can manage people, hold them accountable and maintain high standards.

title: AI Automation Specialist & Developer - Full-Time Remote
description:
AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST & DEVELOPER

Full-time | Remote from the Philippines | 40 hours per week

Salary: Negotiable based on experience



HELP US TURN AI INTO PRACTICAL TOOLS OUR BUSINESSES CAN USE EVERY DAY.



We are an Australian family-owned group of businesses operating across property development, production, farming, and investments. We have an established team in Australia and the Philippines, and we are looking for a hands-on AI Automation Specialist & Developer to help us improve how we work.



This is a full-time remote role for someone based in the Philippines. You will work closely with our owners, managers, and staff across our businesses.



We need someone who can listen to what our teams need, recommend the right solution, and then build it. This could include automating repetitive tasks, creating AI agents, assistants and bots, connecting our business systems, or developing tools that save time and reduce manual work.



Just as importantly, you must be comfortable teaching our staff how to use what you create. We want someone who can explain technology clearly, work well with people, and make AI useful - not complicated.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Work with owners, managers, and staff to identify tasks and processes that could be improved through AI and automation.

- Design, build, and maintain practical workflows, AI agents, assistants, chatbots, and other business tools.

- Connect applications, databases, and business systems so information flows efficiently.

- Develop solutions for administration, customer enquiries, reporting, document processing, and day-to-day operations.

- Test your solutions, troubleshoot problems, and make sure they are reliable and easy to use.

- Train staff through demonstrations, simple instructions, and ongoing support.

- Protect confidential business information and include appropriate access controls and human approvals.

- Recommend useful new AI tools based on genuine business value - not just the latest trend.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are a practical problem-solver who can take a business requirement from an initial conversation through to a working solution.



You should have:



- Proven experience building AI-powered tools and business automations.

- Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar tools.

- Experience using AI models and platforms such as OpenAI/ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable services.

- The ability to work with APIs and integrations, with coding skills in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.

- Strong communication skills and the patience to train colleagues with different levels of technical knowledge.

- The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with our teams.

- A focus on measurable results, such as time saved, fewer errors, and simpler processes.



You do not need to know every tool listed. What matters most is your ability to build effective solutions and help people use them confidently. We are looking for someone who can build and implement solutions, not simply use ChatGPT for everyday tasks.



WHY JOIN US?



This is an opportunity to take ownership of AI and automation across a diverse family business group. You will work directly with decision-makers, collaborate with our Australian and Philippine teams, and see your work make a real difference.



We are looking for a long-term team member who can grow with our businesses.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Your CV and a short introduction.

2. Two or three examples of automations, bots, or AI tools you have built. Explain what they did, which tools you used, and the results achieved. Screenshots, a portfolio, or a short demonstration video are welcome. Please do not share confidential client information.

3. A short description of how you would identify automation opportunities in a business and train staff to use your solutions.

4. Your current location in the Philippines, earliest start date, and salary expectations, including currency and whether the amount is monthly or hourly.



If you enjoy building useful technology and helping people work smarter, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement

Remote | Full-time |



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage).

Website: 
/

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.) High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.) Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.) Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥
