title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly analytical, results-driven Amazon PPC Manager to join our growing e-commerce team.



The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience managing Amazon advertising campaigns, a proven track record of driving sales growth, and the ability to optimize advertising spend while maintaining profitability.



You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing Amazon PPC strategies across multiple products and marketplaces, with a strong focus on ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, sales growth, and overall profitability.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon PPC Campaign Management



-Create, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

-Develop data-driven PPC strategies to increase sales, improve organic rankings, and maximize profitability.

-Manage advertising budgets across multiple products, campaigns, and marketplaces.

-Plan and execute PPC strategies for new product launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns.

-Monitor campaign performance daily and make timely adjustments to improve results.



2. Keyword Research & Bid Optimization

-Conduct comprehensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and search term harvesting.

-Optimize keyword bids, placements, targeting, and campaign structures.

-Identify wasted advertising spend and implement effective negative keyword strategies.

-Monitor keyword rankings and adjust campaigns to improve visibility and conversion.

-Utilize manual and automated bidding strategies to maximize advertising efficiency.



3. Performance Analysis & Reporting

-Monitor and analyze key metrics, including ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, advertising spend, and total sales.

-Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions.

-Prepare clear, actionable weekly and monthly PPC performance reports.

-Provide data-driven recommendations to improve campaign efficiency, profitability, and sales growth.

-Evaluate the relationship between advertising performance, organic sales, and overall business performance.



4. PPC Tools, Automation & AI

-Manage advertising campaigns through Amazon Seller Central and Advertising Console.

-Utilize research and analytics tools such as Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout, or similar platforms.

-Manage and optimize campaigns using PPC automation software such as Perpetua, Pacvue, BidX, or equivalent tools.

-Leverage AI-powered tools for keyword research, campaign analysis, bid optimization, and reporting.

-Stay informed about Amazon Advertising updates, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.



5. Collaboration & Business Growth

-Collaborate with listing optimization, inventory, operations, and marketing teams to align PPC strategies with business objectives.

-Adjust advertising strategies based on inventory availability, product margins, and sales performance.

-Conduct competitor and market research to identify growth opportunities.

-Recommend strategies to improve organic visibility, market share, and overall brand profitability.



Qualifications & Requirements



Required Qualifications



-Minimum of 3 years of proven, hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns.

-Demonstrated success in managing Amazon advertising accounts and achieving measurable improvements in sales and profitability.

-Advanced knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display advertising.

-Experience managing substantial monthly advertising budgets across multiple campaigns or products.

-Strong understanding of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and other key Amazon advertising metrics.

-Proficiency in Amazon Seller Central and Advertising Console.

-Hands-on experience with Helium 10, DataDive, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon analytics tools.

-Practical experience using PPC automation and bid-management software.

-Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

-Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

-Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and consistently meet performance targets in a remote environment.



How to Apply



Interested applicants should send a message with the subject line "PPC Manager" and include:



Relevant Experience: A brief overview of your hands-on Amazon PPC management experience, including the marketplaces and types of campaigns you have managed.



Proven Results: Specific examples of PPC performance improvements you have achieved, such as reduced ACoS, improved TACoS, increased ROAS, or sales growth.



Tools & Platforms: A list of the Amazon PPC management, analytics, automation, and AI tools you have used.



Portfolio or Profile: A link to your professional profile, portfolio, or relevant case studies.



Important: This position is intended for experienced Amazon PPC professionals. Only candidates with proven, hands-on Amazon PPC management experience and demonstrable results will be considered.

title: Creative Video Editor – AI ADS for Meta, TikTok & more
description:
A lot of editors can make a video look good. Far fewer can make one that stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're looking for an AI video ad maker and editor who belongs to the second group.



Our brand sells online in the health supplement niche and it's growing quickly. Since paid social is one of our main growth channels, video creative is not "content" to us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the whole business.



We want someone on the team who can help us turn out high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



The ideal person understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative and UGC-style ads, and knows the value of fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.





WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON:



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



- AI drama ads: cinematic, story-based ads created entirely with AI

- Song-driven ads: video ads with a song at the center

- Higgsfield animated ads: fully generated Pixar-style creatives made with nano banana pro, Kling and Seedance

- Customer testimonial videos: edits built on reviews, before/after moments and social proof that create emotion and trust

- Variations for creative testing: new hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

- Avatar ads made with AI: you create realistic avatars from photos, animate them in HeyGen, and voice them with ElevenLabs using our scripts

- Meta ads 
 and Instagram): scroll-stopping videos made to catch attention quickly and get the purchase

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Product-in-action videos: clear, benefit-focused demonstration edits

- UGC-style videos: organic-looking, believable creatives that feel native and platform-friendly





THE EDITOR WE'RE AFTER:



No "cinematic" editors who only care about pretty visuals, please. We need people who understand how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



- Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

- Get the benefits across quickly and clearly

- Earn trust using social proof, reviews, and testimonials

- Present the product in a clear and persuasive way

- Maintain attention using b-roll, overlays, zooms, cuts and captions

- Feel at home on
, Instagram and TikTok

- Present the problem so it feels real and urgent

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



Given a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references and creative notes, you should be able to turn them into a polished ad that's ready to test. And if there's no footage at all, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.





THE RIGHT FIT:



You will thrive here if you:



- Produce real creatives with AI tools hands-on, instead of only experimenting with them

- Already have experience editing e-commerce video ads

- Care whether your videos really perform, not just whether they look good

- Are comfortable with feedback and iterate fast

- Can take simple footage and make it compelling and conversion-focused

- Have a strong feel for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can use references as a guide instead of copying them blindly

- Are able to turn out multiple ad variations quickly

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative



What we care about is creative that sells. Not ugly, not low-quality: it simply means every editing choice has to support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.





TOOLS & EXPERIENCE:



You need to have worked with:



- HeyGen (photo-based avatar creation and realistic animation)

- ElevenLabs: voiceover and text-to-speech

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance), for generated and animated video

- A minimum of 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools (occasional use doesn't count)



You also have experience with:



- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

- Captioning, overlays, motion graphics, sound design, b-roll, and pacing

- Paid social short-form videos

- Long-form VSLs / sales videos

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives



Having worked in the health supplement niche is a nice bonus.





YOUR TASKS:



- Making variations of winning ads to test further

- Uploading completed videos to Google Drive, named clearly and kept organized

- Using feedback from ad results to produce stronger iterations

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Improving hooks, captions, pacing, visuals and CTAs

- Creating and animating avatars in HeyGen

- Editing using music, sound effects, voiceover, subtitles, and transitions

- Editing new ads from scripts, footage, UGC clips and references

- Teaming up with the creative and marketing team to improve performance

- Making Pixar-style animated ads using Higgsfield

- Resizing and adapting creatives for different aspect ratios and platforms

- Researching and collecting clips for our VSLs





WHAT WE OFFER:



- Competitive pay, based on your experience

- Clear direction on the creative side and quick feedback

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- A long-term path with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants to take on more responsibility over time

- Full-time work: 40 hours per week



We are building a serious e-commerce brand. To do that, we need someone who knows how to make ads that get attention, build trust and convert.

title: CPA - ACCOUNTING MANAGER
description:
# Hiring: Accounting Manager (Active Philippine CPA Required)



**Location:** Davao City or Panabo City, Philippines ONLY  

**Compensation:** $8 USD per hour  

**Benefits:** Health Insurance, Retirement Benefits, 13th Month Pay  

**Position:** Full-Time



### About the Role



We are seeking an experienced Accounting Manager who holds an **active Philippine CPA license** to lead a team of 4 bookkeepers responsible for approximately 80 small business bookkeeping clients.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience reviewing financial statements, managing accounting teams, and ensuring accurate accrual-based accounting.



### Key Responsibilities



- Lead and supervise a team of 4 bookkeepers managing approximately 80 clients.

- Review monthly balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and general ledgers.

- Ensure proper accrual accounting and compliance with US GAAP.

- Identify unusual balances, variances, misclassifications, and accounting errors.

- Investigate discrepancies and ensure corrections are made before financial statements are delivered to clients.

- Proactively ask questions and challenge transactions or balances that do not make sense.

- Review bank reconciliations, adjusting journal entries, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and accrued expenses.

- Ensure timely and accurate monthly financial reporting.

- Train, mentor, and hold bookkeepers accountable for their work.

- Take ownership of financial statement accuracy and quality control.



### Mandatory Qualifications



- **ACTIVE PHILIPPINE CPA LICENSE REQUIRED. Expired or inactive licenses will NOT be accepted.**

- **Must currently reside in Davao City or Panabo City, Philippines.**

- Proven experience managing and supervising an accounting team.

- Extensive experience reviewing financial statements, not just preparing them.

- Strong knowledge of accrual accounting and US GAAP.

- Proficiency in QuickBooks Online.

- Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience handling multiple small business clients.

- Excellent English communication and leadership skills.



### Compensation & Benefits



- $8 USD per hour

- Full-time employment

- Health insurance

- Retirement benefits

- 13th month pay

- Long-term career growth opportunities



### Who We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply checks bookkeeping entries.



We need an experienced accounting leader who understands financial statements, recognizes when numbers do not make sense, investigates variances, asks the right questions, and ensures accurate financial reporting before anything is sent to clients.



### IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



**DO NOT APPLY unless you meet ALL of the following requirements:**



1. You currently hold an **ACTIVE Philippine CPA license**.

2. You currently reside in **Davao City or Panabo City, Philippines**.

3. You have prior experience **managing an accounting team**.

4. You have substantial experience **reviewing financial statements and ensuring accrual accounting accuracy**.



**Applicants who do not meet ALL four requirements will not be considered.**

We are looking for an experienced YouTube Scriptwriter who knows how to create engaging scripts that keep viewers watching until the end.



We need someone who understands YouTube storytelling, audience retention, and how to write effective titles and descriptions that help videos perform better.



Requirements:



- Proven experience writing scripts for YouTube channels.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, hooks, curiosity, and audience retention.

- Ability to analyze YouTube channels and adapt scripts to match their style and audience.

- Understand what makes viewers click on a video and continue watching.

- Available for long-term collaboration (1+ years).



Salary is negotiable based on experience and proven results.



We provide all the tools, subscriptions, and resources needed for the job.



To Apply (REQUIRED):



- Attach 1–2 YouTube videos you personally wrote scripts for.

- Provide proof of performance if available (views, average view duration, retention graphs, or CTR).

- Briefly explain your contribution to those videos and the results achieved.



BONUS: Attach a short video explaining your experience. We will prioritize applicants with relevant examples and proven results.



IMPORTANT: Please do not send generic portfolios or unrelated writing samples. We are looking for someone with real YouTube scriptwriting experience who understands storytelling, audience retention, and video performance.



Applications without relevant examples will not be considered.



Final question: What is your favorite movie?

title: Virtual Assistant – Car Rental Operations (Part-Time)
description:

Company: Lotus Rentals

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Pay: $3.10 USD per hour

Pay Schedule: Bi-Weekly (Every 2 Weeks)

Schedule: Set Schedule 



Work Schedule: A minimum of 2-3 hours and 20 minutes per day, 5 days per week, with opportunities for additional hours based on individual performance and business needs.



Growth Opportunity: This position is expected to transition into a FULL-TIME ROLE as the company continues to grow. Candidates who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, and dedication will be prioritized for increased hours and advancement opportunities.



About Lotus Rentals

Lotus Rentals is a growing car rental company serving customers in Texas and New York. We provide affordable and reliable vehicle rentals for rideshare drivers, commuters, travelers, and everyday transportation needs.

We are looking for a dependable, motivated, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join our team. No car rental experience is required. We are willing to train the right candidate who is eager to learn, take initiative, and grow with the company.

Responsibilities

Respond to customer inquiries via phone, text,
, and social media

Assist customers with reservations and rental questions

Send rental agreements, invoices, and payment reminders

Verify customer documents and information

Update customer records and spreadsheets

Follow up professionally on overdue payments

Post and manage vehicle listings online

Assist with scheduling vehicle pickups and returns

Perform general administrative tasks

Take on additional responsibilities as the company grows

Requirements

Good written and spoken English

Reliable internet connection

Computer or laptop

Strong attention to detail

Professional and dependable

Ability to work independently

Positive attitude and willingness to learn

Strong customer service mindset

Experience

Experience is preferred but not required. We welcome applicants who are eager to learn and grow with our company.

What We're Looking For

Someone who wants a long-term opportunity

Someone who is coachable and willing to learn

Someone who takes initiative

Someone who is organized and dependable

Someone comfortable communicating with customers

Someone interested in growing with a small but expanding business

How to Apply:

Please
 the following to 

Your resume

Internet speed test results

A short introduction about yourself

A 40-second to 1-minute video explaining why you would be a great addition to the Lotus Rentals team

In Your Video

Introduce yourself

Tell us about your work experience

Explain why you would be a great fit for Lotus Rentals

Share what skills and qualities you can bring to our team

Be yourself and let your personality show

Important

Applicants who do not submit the required 40-second to 1-minute video to 
 will not be considered or qualified for this position. The video submission is a mandatory part of the application process.

We are hiring immediately and are willing to train the right candidate. Additional hours and growth opportunities may become available as Lotus Rentals continues to expand.



!!!!!! Experience with GoHighLevel CRM and Google Sheets is a plus. Candidates who claim proficiency with either platform will be required to demonstrate their knowledge and technical skills through a practical assessment during the hiring process!!!!!!

description:

Remote | Long-Term Position | Starting at $3 USD/hour | HOURS PER WEEK: Up to 39 hours



Responsibilities

- Work with Shopify, Re:amaze, Google Sheets, and

- Experience with Shopify and Re:amaze

- Experience communicating with suppliers

- Strong written English and fast typing skills

Please answer ALL the following questions in your application:

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Sales Representative — Credit Repair (Remote, Base + Commission)
description:
CLOSERS ONLY. DO NOT APPLY IF YOU HAVE NEVER CLOSED A SALE.



CP Restoration Services is a US-based credit repair company with real clients, warm leads, and a team built on results. We have been in business since 2014. If you can close, we will pay you well. If you cannot, this is not the job for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Work warm inbound leads — no cold calling

- Make 100 outbound dials per day, Mon–Fri

- Present credit repair packages and close enrollments

- Handle objections with confidence and professionalism

- Follow up relentlessly until you get a yes or a no

- Log every call and outcome in our CRM portal

- Attend the daily 9AM EST team huddle

- Hit your weekly enrollment quota — no exceptions



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE:

- Minimum 2 years of proven sales or closing experience

- Fluent, professional spoken and written English

- Verifiable track record — be ready to discuss your numbers

- Available Mon–Fri 9AM–5PM EST, no exceptions

- Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps+ required)

- Computer with noise-cancelling headset

- Quiet, professional workspace



DO NOT APPLY IF:

- You have never closed a sale

- You need a script for every call

- You are not available EST hours

- You are applying just for the base salary



COMPENSATION:

- Base salary: $400/month USD — earned by completing 100 dials/week

- Commission paid on top of every closed enrollment

- Meets Target (1–2 sales/week): $1,000–$2,000+/month

- Exceeds Target (3+ sales/week): $3,000–$5,000+/month

- You have 2 weeks from your start date to close your first sale. No sale in 2 weeks = employment ends.



IMPORTANT:

Training and onboarding are NOT compensated. They are pre-employment requirements. We provide warm leads, full product training, a CRM portal, and management support. You bring the hunger and the work ethic.



TO APPLY: Visit 
/careers.html to submit your application.

title: Executive Assistant (with Legal Backround)
description:
Company: Suits Finance

Work Arrangement: Remote (Full-time)

Compensation: Market-conform salary

Availability: Immediate





About Suits Finance



Suits Finance is a dynamic financial services firm providing data-driven and cross-border solutions for global entrepreneurs, corporate entities, and e-commerce businesses. We specialize in resolving complex financial and compliance-related challenges across multiple jurisdictions, including banking, corporate structuring, and regulatory coordination.



As part of our expansion, we are seeking a Executive Assistant to assist our Legal Department in managing client communications, case coordination, and documentation support related to banking and compliance matters.





Position Overview



As an Executive Assistant for the Legal Department, you will serve as a key point of contact between clients and our legal and compliance teams. You will assist in managing client inquiries, collecting required information, organizing case documentation, and ensuring smooth coordination throughout ongoing legal and compliance cases.



This role focuses on client communication, case coordination, and administrative support, rather than legal decision-making. Strong communication skills, organization, and attention to detail are essential.





Key Responsibilities



Client Communication & Support

-Serve as a primary point of contact for clients regarding ongoing legal and compliance cases.

-Respond to client inquiries and provide clear guidance on required documents and next steps.

-Provide timely updates on case progress and requirements.

-Escalate technical or legal matters to the appropriate internal teams.



Case Coordination & Administrative Support

-Assist in organizing and maintaining client case files and documentation.

-Track case progress, deadlines, and document requirements.

-Coordinate between clients and internal legal/compliance teams.

-Ensure all required information and documents are properly collected and recorded.



Documentation & Internal Support

-Assist in preparing and organizing client-submitted documents for internal review.

-Maintain accurate records of communications and case updates.

As Australia’s leading provider in our space, we empower eligible individuals to access essential medical treatments and alleviate financial strain by facilitating the early release of their Superannuation (retirement savings) on compassionate grounds - to fund their medical or funeral expenses.



Over the past decade, we have transformed thousands of lives across Australia, helping clients ease their financial burdens to focus on what matters most - their health. Headquartered with key hubs in Sydney and Canberra, our nationwide reach is backed by continuous innovation, an exceptional client-first mindset, and a high-performance team culture.



As we expand our impact, we are seeking an experienced, high-empathy Sales Consultant to join our team and drive our mission forward.

As the first point of contact for prospective clients, the Sales Consultant plays a vital role in delivering a compassionate, seamless experience. They will be responsible for guiding interested clients through our service offerings, assessing their eligibility to access Superannuation for medical or funeral expenses, and driving conversion.



They will directly impact the company’s success by meeting and exceeding performance targets across two key pillars: Sales Conversion and Client Engagement.





Key Responsibilities:





Inbound Consultations: Handle inbound sales inquiries, articulate the value of SuperCare’s services, and present tailored solutions with empathy and professionalism. No cold callings, no appointment settings, they will be managing all warm leads from our partner clinics who refer their patients to us.



Pipeline Management: Efficiently guide warm leads through the end-to-end sales funnel following our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) — from clinic referrals to deal closure.



Lead Qualification & Education: Assess client eligibility based on compassionate grounds while clearly and responsibly communicating the implications of early Superannuation withdrawal.



Nurture & Convert: Maintain proactive follow-ups to build trust, address client concerns, and convert qualified prospects into paying clients.



Closing & Onboarding: Ensure complete client understanding of Service Agreements, assist with digital agreement signing, and guide clients through the online payment process.



Handle general line inbound call operations, ensuring seamless call routing, accurate message taking, and an excellent first-impression experience.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR





Experience: Minimum 1 year of proven B2C sales experience in a professional or corporate setting — ideally within healthcare, insurance, financial services, or allied industries.



Communication/Language Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills with strong attention to detail and high emotional intelligence.



Consultative Selling: Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly, actively listen, and match client needs with personalized solutions.



Tech Proficiency: Comfortable navigating CRM platforms such as Salesforce and other modern digital productivity tools.



Adaptability & Integrity: Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment while adhering strictly to regulatory compliance and internal standards.



Empathy & Drive: A client-first attitude combined with a results-oriented mindset.







WHAT WE OFFER





Competitive Compensation commensurate with experience.

Work Culture: A supportive, dynamic environment focused on delivering a great team experience.



Comprehensive and structured Onboarding and Training.

Fast, reliable internet connection.



Stable power arrangement with a backup solution (e.g., UPS) to ensure uninterrupted operations.

title: Google Ads Manager, Professional Services Lead Generation (US Tax Advisory Firm)
description:
Job Title: Google Ads Manager, Professional Services Lead Generation (US Tax Advisory Firm)



Type: Part-time contractor, ongoing monthly retainer

Hours: 10-15 professional hours per month

Schedule: Flexible. Must be available for a 30-minute check-in call every two weeks during US Eastern business hours 11 am-2 pm ET / 11 pm-2 am PHT).

Compensation: . Negotiable for candidates who can demonstrate 5+ years of documented professional services PPC management with verifiable results.



---



The Firm



Simonsgroup Tax Advisory is a strategic tax planning firm in Washington, DC. Not tax preparation. Not seasonal filing. Our clients are business owners ($300K-$5M revenue), high-income tech professionals, and real estate investors. Engagement values range from $1,800 to $10,000+.



The Google Ads account runs Search campaigns in the DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia metro area. Monthly ad spend: approximately $2,000. The only conversion that matters: intake form submissions that result in booked advisory consultations.



---



Why This Role Exists



The account has been through three vendor relationships in eight months. Each produced the same pattern: generic reporting without actual data, keyword strategies that attracted tax preparation shoppers instead of advisory clients, and tracking configurations that inflated conversion counts while real lead quality degraded.



Two independent audits have been completed. A separate Phase 1 engagement will fix the structural and tracking issues those audits identified (GA4 misconfiguration, conversion tag duplication, broken Enhanced Conversions, campaign restructuring, landing page alignment). Phase 1 must be complete before this engagement begins.



This role picks up after the foundation is repaired. Your job: keep the data clean, keep the budget protected from waste, and steadily improve cost per qualified lead.



---



Weekly: Search Term and Negative Keyword Management (4-5 hours/month)



The most important recurring task. Corporate tax keywords cost $10-$25 per click. Without weekly review, Google's algorithms will match your ads to consumer tax prep queries, IRS self-service searches, competitor name lookups, and job seekers within days. This has been documented and measured in this account.



Every week:



- Pull the search terms report for the prior 7 days

- Review every query that generated a click

- Add negative keywords for competitor names, consumer queries ("free tax services," "file my taxes"), IRS self-service queries ("irs payment plan," "form 9465"), job seeker queries ("bookkeeping jobs remote"), and out-of-market locations

- All negatives as phrase match. Not exact match. Exact match negatives let variants through. This has been a recurring vendor failure on this account.

- Maintain a running log: date, keyword, match type, rationale

- Flag any emerging search pattern that suggests a keyword or ad group adjustment



Weekly means weekly. A competitor name that collects 3 clicks before it is blocked costs $30-$75.



---



Bi-weekly: Performance Monitoring and Bid Management (2-3 hours/month)



- Flag any keyword with $75+ spend and zero conversions over a rolling 30-day window

- Monitor geographic performance. DC and Maryland convert. Virginia locations have historically shown near-zero activity. Diagnose and recommend if that pattern continues.

- Monitor device performance. Mobile has consistently outperformed desktop on conversion rate in this account.

- Verify ad scheduling restricts spend to business hours. No serving between 10pm and 6am.

- Review auction insights monthly. Track competitive position against 
, H&R Block, and Intuit.



---



Bi-weekly: Reporting (2-3 hours/month)



Written report every two weeks. Data, not descriptions. Every report includes:



- Spend by campaign and ad group

- Impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, cost per conversion by ad group

- Search impression share: total, lost to budget, lost to rank

- Top-of-page rate and absolute top-of-page rate

- Quality scores for top 10 keywords by spend (including Landing Page Experience, Ad Relevance, Expected CTR sub-scores)

- Auction insights: top 5 competitors by impression share

- Top 15 search terms by spend with clicks, cost, conversions

- Negative keywords added during the period (from the running log)

- Location performance by targeted area

- Device performance breakdown

- Conversion action health: verify tag is firing, confirm primary/secondary configuration, reconcile Google Ads conversions against Tally form submission count

- Actions taken since last report (specific changes, not descriptions of process)

- Recommendations for next period with rationale



Reports that describe what a metric means without providing the actual number will not be accepted. Three consecutive vendors delivered reports with section headers and metric definitions but no data. That is the standard this role replaces.



---



Monthly: Ad Copy Testing (1-2 hours/month)



- Maintain at least 3 responsive search ad variations per ad group

- Test headlines reflecting advisory positioning: S-Corp strategy, entity structuring, high-income tax planning, real estate investor tax, IRS resolution

- Pause underperformers based on CTR and conversion rate. Not ad strength scores.

- Ensure ad copy aligns with landing page content



---



Ongoing: Conversion Tracking Integrity



Phase 1 fixes the tracking. This role keeps it clean.



- Test the intake form conversion tag quarterly (submit a test form, confirm it registers in Google Ads)

- Monitor for double-counting anomalies (any keyword with a conversion rate above 100% gets investigated immediately)

- Verify conversion values remain correctly assigned ($200-$500 per lead type)

- Reconcile Google Ads click count against GA4 paid sessions monthly

- Reconcile reported conversions against Tally submission count bi-weekly



The account has a documented history of tracking failures that corrupted Smart Bidding. Ongoing verification is not optional.



---



Required Experience



Minimum 5 years managing Google Ads Search campaigns for professional services firms: law firms, accounting firms, financial advisory, tax advisory, consulting, or medical practices. You must have managed at least 3 accounts in this category over that period.



General experience with e-commerce, local trades (plumbing, HVAC, landscaping), or app install campaigns does not substitute. The keyword economics, conversion paths, and lead quality standards for a $5,000 advisory engagement are fundamentally different from a $200 service call.



Additional requirements:



- Demonstrated experience with form-based or consultation-based conversion tracking, not e-commerce transactions

- Proficient with impression share analysis, quality score diagnostics, auction insights, and search term management at the query level

- Understands how conversion action configuration (primary vs. secondary, count setting, attribution window, value assignment) affects Smart Bidding behavior

- Can diagnose geographic targeting issues (e.g., algorithm deprioritizing specific locations due to budget constraints)

- Clear, data-driven written reporting in English

- Works in the client's own Google Ads account via MCC access



Preferred:



- Experience managing campaigns in the US professional services market

- Familiarity with Tally, Calendly, or similar form/scheduling-based conversion tracking

- Experience with Maximize Conversions and Target CPA bidding transitions

- Google Ads Search certification



---



Account Access



The Google Ads account is owned by Simonsgroup. You receive manager-level access via MCC. Account ownership does not transfer. All campaigns, keywords, ads, conversion tracking, and work product remain in the Simonsgroup account. If the engagement ends, the account continues with no disruption.



---



Timezone



The firm operates on US Eastern time. Bi-weekly check-in calls: 8am-12pm ET (8pm-12am PHT). Async communication via email for everything else. Responsiveness within 24 hours on business days is expected.



---



How to Apply



Answer all four questions. Applications that skip any question or send a generic cover letter will not be reviewed.



1. Name 2-3 professional services firms (law, accounting, financial advisory, medical) where you managed Google Ads on a monthly retainer for at least 6 months. For each: monthly ad spend, qualified leads per month, cost per qualified lead, and the single most impactful change you made. Anonymize client names if needed.



2. You pull this week's search terms report and see 8 of the top 20 queries by spend are people searching for specific CPA names ("john smith cpa," "abc tax services"). They generated $110 in clicks and zero conversions. What do you do, what match type for the negatives, and why that match type?



3. Google Ads shows 4 conversions this period. The intake form platform shows 7 submissions. What are the possible explanations and what would you check first?



4. Your monthly rate for this scope and hours.



Applications that answer all four questions with specifics will be prioritized. The next step is a short paid test task (compensated at your rate) before any ongoing engagement begins.

title: YouTube Channel Manager / Video Production VA
description:
About Us

We run a growing network of YouTube channels and use AI tools, mainly Claude and VidRush, to produce our videos efficiently. We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to manage the full video production workflow, from script to scheduled upload. No video editing or scriptwriting experience required: we provide clear SOPs for every format, and you follow the process.



Growth Path

You'll start on 1 channel during your training period, so you can learn our formats, SOPs and quality standards step by step. Once you're working independently and consistently, we'll expand your responsibilities to 10+ channels. At that point there is enough work for a full-time workweek, and this is meant to be a long-term role.



What You'll Do

For each video, you will:

1. Generate the script using Claude (AI) by submitting our SOP for the specific video format together with the video title.

2. Review the script carefully and make adjustments where needed (flow, accuracy, consistency with our format and tone).

3. Create the video in VidRush AI using the approved script.

4. Check the finished video for quality: visuals, voice-over, pacing, errors, and anything that doesn't match the script.

5. Upload the video to the correct YouTube channel with the right settings (title, description, tags, thumbnail, category, playlists, audience settings, etc.).

6. Schedule the video according to our posting calendar.



Requirements

- Excellent written English: this is the most important requirement. You will review every script, so you must be able to tell whether English text reads naturally and correctly.

- Strong attention to detail

- Able to follow SOPs and work independently

- Reliable internet connection and your own computer



Experience with YouTube Studio or AI tools like Claude is a plus, but not required. We will train you.



Compensation

- $2 USD per completed video (non-monetized channels)

- $3 USD per completed video (monetized channels)

- Performance bonus: up to $50 USD per channel per month when a channel performs well. With 10+ channels, that means up to $500+ in monthly bonuses on top of your video pay.

- A video counts as completed when it is reviewed, uploaded with the correct settings, and scheduled.

- During training (1 channel) the volume will be lower. As we scale to 10+ channels, the workload will grow to a full-time workweek.

- Payment is made [weekly / biweekly] via [PayPal / Wise / other].



How to Apply

To show us you read the full post, start your application with the words "SCHEDULED AND READY". Applications without this will not be considered.

- A short introduction about yourself

- Your experience with YouTube and/or AI tools (if any)

- How many videos you can realistically handle per day or week

- Your availability (hours per day/week and time zone overlap)



Write your application yourself, in your own words. Your application is also your English test.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a short paid test task.

Furry Muse designs fashion-first, performance-built pet accessories: harnesses, walkwear, leashes, collars and 18K gold-plated jewelry. Since the viral Wander! Bow Harness, we've built a loyal community of pet parents and been featured in BuzzFeed, Modern Luxury, ABC7NY and Yahoo. We sell on Shopify, TikTok Shop and Faire, with Chewy coming soon. Founder-led and fully remote: our founder is in Singapore, our small team is global.



THE ROLE

Part-time finance manager to own our numbers: sit above our external bookkeeper, keep management reporting tied to the books, and coordinate Singapore and US tax filings with our advisers.

- Phase 1: 4-6 week project to fix our reporting, about 60-80 hours (12-15 hrs/week)

- Phase 2: ongoing retainer, about 15-25 hours a month, offered to the same person once Phase 1 is accepted



PHASE 1 DELIVERABLES

- Map our Google Sheets management report to QuickBooks accounts and reconcile year to date (variances over 1-2% explained)

- Reconcile Shopify, TikTok Shop and Faire payouts into QuickBooks (A2X or similar)

- Value US, China and in-transit inventory on a documented landed-cost method (incl. duties), tied to the balance sheet

- Reconcile intercompany balances between our Singapore parent and US LLC

- Set the month-end close calendar with the bookkeeper; build the monthly P&L pack and run one live close

- Build a rolling 13-week cash forecast

- Prepare data packs and a filing calendar for our tax advisers (they file)

- Document everything

Accepted when the year-to-date report ties to QuickBooks within 1-2% and one live close is delivered on time.



PHASE 2

Review the bookkeeper's work, produce the monthly P&L pack, keep reporting tied to the books, check inventory/COGS, update the cash forecast, prepare payments for our approval, track tax deadlines, and review monthly with our CFO and founder. Not included: signing tax filings, releasing payments, annual budgeting.



REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years in finance/accounting, ideally DTC or ecommerce

- Hands-on QuickBooks Online and Shopify/marketplace payout reconciliation

- Multi-location inventory accounting (landed cost, goods in transit)

- Multi-entity, multi-currency and intercompany experience

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel; has built a management report or cash forecast

- Clear written English; overlap with Singapore hours (UTC+8)

- CPA strongly preferred; non-CPAs with clear ecommerce and inventory experience considered

- Nice to have: US sales tax or Singapore compliance, ShipHero, Airwallex, Mercury

No Singapore or US tax expertise needed.



HOW WE WORK

- Independent contractor, remote, Philippines-based

- Reports to our part-time CFO (an investor), working with the founder; weekly check-in in Phase 1, monthly after

- Tools: Slack, QuickBooks, Shopify, ShipHero, Google Drive

- View-only bank access; no payment release; NDA required

- Rate: US$12-20/hour, hours capped and agreed in writing

- Shortlisted candidates do a paid 2-3 hour trial task

1. How would you reconcile Shopify, TikTok Shop and Faire payouts in QuickBooks?

2. How would you value stock held in China, in transit and in a US warehouse, including duties?

- Spot what's working and scale it. When a concept wins, we make more of it.



Why this seat is different

- You see the data. You get access to all our performance numbers, so you always know what's working and why.

- Weekly call with your lead. We go through your ads together, you get direct feedback, and you level up off it. No guessing.

- We pay for your tools. Every AI tool and subscription you need is on us. Find a new one that makes you faster or better? Tell us and we'll get it.



Full-time, long-term. We want someone in the business with us.



Where this can lead

Editor → Editor Lead → (if it's really in you) Creative Strategist.



Every step is a pay rise, based on performance. If you start thinking about why an ad works, not just how to cut it, you'll move fast.



You'll thrive here if

- You already live in AI video tools and get excited when a new model drops

- You think in hooks, pacing and retention, not filters and transitions

- You need everything spelled out before you can produce

None of those people last here.

title: Senior SEO Specialist – Australian Education Company (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About us:



We are an established Australian education company with over 15 years of experience helping students achieve academic success.



We have a strong online presence, an established brand, and an ambitious growth strategy. We are currently investing in a new, faster, modern website and want an experienced SEO professional to take full ownership of our organic search performance.



This is an opportunity to join a growing international company, work directly with our management team, and have a meaningful impact on the business.



About the Role:



We are looking for a highly experienced SEO specialist who can independently manage and execute our entire SEO strategy.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are not looking for someone who has completed a short SEO course or has a basic understanding of search engine optimisation.



We want someone with at least 5 years of hands-on SEO experience, a proven track record of improving organic rankings and traffic, and an excellent understanding of how SEO is evolving with AI-powered search.



You will be responsible for both developing the strategy and executing it.



Key Responsibilities:



SEO Strategy & Technical Optimisation



- Take ownership of our overall SEO strategy and organic growth.



- Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.



- Analyse website architecture, internal linking, crawlability, indexing, redirects, and structured data.



- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.



- Optimise existing pages and identify opportunities for new high-performing landing pages.



- Work closely with our web developer and designer to implement technical and on-page improvements.



- Monitor algorithm updates and adapt our strategy accordingly.



Link Building & Outreach



- Develop and execute a high-quality backlink acquisition strategy.



- Identify and secure relevant backlinks from genuine, authoritative Australian websites.



- Conduct outreach to Australian education websites, parenting blogs, publications, schools, and other relevant organisations.



- Build relationships that create ongoing link-building opportunities.



- Audit existing backlinks and identify opportunities and risks.



- Focus on sustainable, white-hat link building — no spam, link farms, or PBNs.



Analytics & Performance



- Expertly use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Ahrefs (or similar).



- Monitor rankings, impressions, CTR, organic traffic, and conversions.



- Investigate ranking declines and identify actionable solutions.



- Produce clear, actionable performance reports.



- Identify opportunities based on data rather than assumptions.



- Track the impact of SEO activities and demonstrate measurable results.



AI Search Optimisation (AEO / GEO)



- Develop strategies to improve our visibility in AI-powered search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.



- Understand Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).



- Implement content and technical improvements to increase our visibility in AI-generated answers.



- Stay informed about developments in AI search and emerging best practices.





Requirements



Essential:



Minimum 5 years of professional, hands-on SEO experience.



Proven track record of achieving meaningful improvements in organic rankings, traffic, and conversions.



Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Ahrefs.



Strong technical SEO knowledge, including indexing, crawling, redirects, structured data, and site architecture.



Demonstrated experience acquiring high-quality, relevant backlinks through genuine outreach.



Experience with Australian, UK, or US websites and competitive English-language search markets.



Up-to-date knowledge of AI search and modern SEO strategies.



Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and take ownership of results.



Strong written English and communication skills.



Comfortable collaborating with developers and designers.



Highly Desirable:



Experience working on large websites with thousands of pages.



Experience with local SEO and location-based landing pages.



Familiarity with modern website frameworks, including Astro or other JavaScript-based websites.



Experience recovering websites from ranking declines or managing major website migrations.



Previous experience in the education industry.





What We Offer



Long-term, stable, full-time remote employment.



Opportunity to work with an established Australian company.



Direct access to management and the ability to influence business strategy.



Access to professional SEO tools and support from our development and design teams.



Freedom to recommend and implement strategies rather than simply following instructions.



Salary negotiable based on your experience, capabilities, and results.



Opportunities for salary growth as you demonstrate value.





How to Apply



We are only interested in applicants who can demonstrate real SEO expertise.



Please include the following in your application:



Your SEO experience: How many years have you worked professionally in SEO, and what types of websites have you managed?



Proof of results: Provide at least two case studies demonstrating improvements you personally achieved in organic traffic, rankings, or conversions. Screenshots from Google Search Console or Ahrefs are strongly preferred.



Link-building experience: Explain how you acquire high-quality backlinks, particularly from Australian websites. Include examples of links you have successfully secured.



AI search knowledge: Explain what you are currently doing to optimise websites for AI-powered search engines.



Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.



Please be specific about the work you personally performed and the measurable results you achieved.



Applications without relevant examples of previous SEO work will not be considered.



We are looking for someone exceptional who wants to grow with our company over the long term.

title: TikTok Shop Growth Manager for Seasonal Product — Amazon MCF, Creator Content
description:
We are an established novelty and gag-gift brand looking for an experienced TikTok Shop Manager to grow our TikTok Shop sales during November and December.



Our products are highly visual, unusual and designed to generate immediate reactions. They are natural scroll-stoppers, well suited to entertaining short-form content and frequently purchased on impulse. A previous TikTok account manager described our brand as “perfect for the TikTok Shop platform.”



Our previous TikTok success



Our products already have a proven history on TikTok. Affiliates—including creators without large followings—have generated millions of views, with successful videos producing thousands of product sales per day.



TikTok activity has also created a significant halo effect across Amazon and our other sales channels. However, our objective is to make TikTok Shop independently profitable rather than relying on sales generated elsewhere.



Our TikTok Shop performance has not yet been stable or consistent. November and December are our most important months, and we want to give the channel a focused push with an experienced operator.

Our hero products each sell approximately 20,000 units on Amazon during December without relying on TikTok. With the right TikTok Shop strategy, creator programme and content volume, we believe there is a substantial opportunity to generate incremental sales directly through TikTok Shop.



This is an ambitious growth project, and we are looking for someone who can create a practical, commercially sound plan—not simply promise viral results.



What we need



TikTok Shop management

* Build and execute a focused November–December growth plan.

* Get 200 affiliate product videos ASAP

* Integrate MCF so Amazon can fulfil order

* Optimise our hero-product listings, pricing, promotions, vouchers and offers.

* Monitor shop health, policy compliance, fulfilment performance and customer experience.

* Provide clear weekly reporting covering GMV, orders, creator activity, advertising and profitability.



Amazon MCF integration

We currently hold inventory with Amazon and want TikTok Shop orders fulfilled through Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment.

The successful candidate should be able to:

* Configure and test Amazon MCF for TikTok Shop.

* Map products, SKUs, inventory and orders correctly.

* Ensure tracking information flows back to TikTok Shop correctly.

* Configure an appropriate return process.

* Troubleshoot fulfilment, inventory or tracking problems.

* Recommend the best integration based on our existing systems.



We currently use Helium 10 and ShipStation. I believe Helium 10 already has a MCF integration tool. Please explain whether either platform can support the proposed workflow or whether you recommend a different integration.



At this stage, we are hesitant to send substantial inventory to Fulfilled by TikTok because the channel has not yet proven itself for us.



Creator and affiliate programme

Our initial target is to generate at least 200 product videos from relevant TikTok creators and affiliates.

Responsibilities will include:

* Identifying and recruiting suitable creators.

* Managing targeted and open affiliate collaborations.

* Coordinating product samples.

* Following up with creators who receive products.

* Creating briefs with strong hooks, demonstrations and content angles. We already know what works and have a proven script.

* Developing appropriate commission and incentive structures.

* Tracking samples, posting rates, videos, views, sales and creator-attributed GMV.

* Identifying successful creators and encouraging them to produce additional content.



Creators do not need large followings. We care more about entertaining content, product fit, consistency and sales performance.

An existing network or warm list of relevant US TikTok creators would be a significant advantage. Please describe the size and relevance of your current creator network, but do not claim access to creators you have not personally worked with.



Content and advertising

Depending on your experience, the role may also include:

* Creating TikTok-native videos for our brand account.

* Coordinating video production with creators or editors.

* Developing funny, reaction-led and gifting-focused content concepts.

* Posting and managing content on our TikTok account.

* Identifying winning affiliate content for amplification.

* Managing TikTok Shop Ads, Spark Ads or GMV Max campaigns.

* Monitoring advertising performance and contribution margin.

Please be clear about which of these activities you personally perform and which would require additional creators, editors or media buyers.

However getting Creators to create 200 videos of our product would be a more important priority.



Required qualifications

* Demonstrable hands-on experience managing TikTok Shop for physical-product brands.

* Previous experience with TikTok Shop affiliates and creator outreach.

* Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, FBA (desired) and MCF.

* Strong understanding of TikTok Shop fulfilment and tracking requirements.

* Experience reading and acting on TikTok Shop performance data.

* Ability to work independently and move quickly during a seasonal campaign.

* Clear written and spoken English.

* Availability to begin immediately and remain actively engaged throughout November and December.



Particularly valuable experience

* Novelty products, gag gifts, unusual gifts or impulse-purchase products.

* Seasonal gifting campaigns.

* Comedy, reaction or entertainment-led content.

* An understanding of US and UK humour, language and cultural references.

* An existing network of TikTok Shop creators.

* TikTok Shop UK management.

* GMV Max, Spark Ads or TikTok Shop Ads.

* Scaling a hero product through affiliate content.



Please include the following in your application

1. Evidence from TikTok Shops you have personally managed.

2. Results you personally helped generate, including GMV, orders and affiliate performance. Please send links to viral videos and store sales that are publicly available, so we can verify for ourselves.

3. Your exact responsibilities on each account.

4. The Amazon MCF integrations you have personally configured.

5. Your proposed plan for the first 7, 30 and 60 days.

6. How you would generate 200 product videos during the project.

7. The number of creators you would expect to contact, sample and activate.

8. Your previous sample-to-post rate, if available.

9. Whether you personally create videos or coordinate creators and editors.

10. Your experience with TikTok Shop Ads, Spark Ads or GMV Max.

11. Your availability, location, time zone and expected weekly hours.

12. Your proposed fixed price or hourly rate for the two-month engagement.

Please begin your application with the words “Novelty TikTok Shop” so we know you have read the complete description.



Please let us know if you are an official TikTok Shop partnered agency (desired).

title: Book Editor and Fact-Checker for a Warm, Practical Self-Help Book (American English, About 45,000 Words)
description:
This book is a practical guide, the voice is warm and honest, like one friend talking to another. Short sentences. Specific details. A little humor.

The full first draft is written. We need a careful, skilled editor to check everything and make it read beautifully, without losing the human voice.



What you'll do

Read the full draft and the style guide, then build a style sheet (spellings, terms, numbers, capitalization, recurring Spanish words).

Check the structure. Every stage follows the same fixed template, and the action always comes before the explanation. You check all 33.

Check fixed terms. Seven terms must be used exactly the same way every time (for example, "stage," never "lesson").

Fact-check. Verify every research claim and number against a reliable source. Anything you can't verify goes in the fact-check log. You never fix a fact by guessing.

Flag unsourced stories and quotes. Every pilgrim story needs a source note. If one is missing, flag it. Don't remove it or rewrite it.

Line edit. Cut filler, tighten long sentences, remove banned words from our list, keep each stage within 600 to 800 words.

Copyedit. Grammar, punctuation, American spelling, consistency.

Log your reasons. Use tracked changes. Put any change to meaning or voice in a comment, as a suggestion. Don't make it silently.

Do a second pass after the author reviews your edits.

The most important rule



Protect the voice. This book is meant to sound like a real person, not a perfect one. Some short fragments, some plain words, and some slightly imperfect rhythm are on purpose. Your job is to make it clearer and cleaner, not smoother or more formal. When in doubt, leave it and add a comment.



You must have

Excellent written English, with a natural feel for casual, conversational American English.

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:

At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.

Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.

title: Residential CAD Drafter for US Homes (Part-Time)
description:
# Residential CAD Drafter for US Homes (Part-Time)



Noir Development builds new homes and duplexes in Dallas, Texas. We're hiring one part-time AutoCAD drafter to test-fit our house plans on lots, build our plan library, and prepare permit sets.



## The work



1. **Lot test-fits.** We send a lot's survey or parcel lines, the zoning setbacks and which of our plans to use. You place the plan, adjust the footprint to fit, and return a 1-page site plan with an area table. Turnaround is 1 business day.

2. **Plan library.** Draw our base plans from our briefs: two-story homes and duplexes. Every plan follows our cost rules:

   - simple footprints and one roof form

   - stacked, back-to-back plumbing

   - 2x6 walls at 24" on center

   - standard stock window sizes

3. **Permit sets.** Adapt a plan to a lot for a City of Dallas permit:

   - every sheet on our checklist

   - 5 business days from a complete brief

   - you confirm your hours before you start

   - framing stays inside IRC prescriptive limits

   - foundation and structural design come from a Texas PE, and engineered truss documents from the truss supplier



## Deliverables



Editable AutoCAD DWGs plus matching PDFs, with organized layers, dimensions, schedules and title blocks.



## You need



- AutoCAD. Revit is a plus

- 2 years drawing US residential plans, in feet and inches, to US code (IRC)

- Production-builder or value-engineering experience

- 2 hours a day of overlap with US Central time

- Clear written English



## Pay and terms



- US$7–9 per hour, about 20 hours a week (up to 86 hours a month), paid monthly for hours worked

- Paid tests first (US$20 and US$40, about 2 and 4 hours), then a paid 30-day trial

- Noir owns all drawings you make for us



## To apply



Reply with:

- "Dallas" on the first line

- 2 US residential plan sets, with the sheets you drew yourself marked

- One change you made to a plan that lowered its build cost, in 2–3 lines

- Confirmation that you deliver editable DWGs

- Your hourly rate

- Your hours of overlap with US Central time

title: Senior Creative Strategist (Philippines)
description:
Senior Creative Strategist (Philippines)



Salary: USD 10.50 to 14.00 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,820 to 2,430 per month, full-time)

Bonus: up to USD 400 per month for winning ads

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00 (NL 07:00 to 16:00), Monday to Friday. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



About Vibrix

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



The role

You own the question: which ads do we make next, and why? You turn customer insights and ad data into new ad concepts, write the briefs, and make sure every test teaches us something.



In your first 90 days you will:

- Review our current ads and customer reviews, and write down what works and what does not.

- Set up a weekly creative testing rhythm: new concepts, clear hypotheses, one report per week.

- Write briefs for UGC creators, designers and video editors, and give feedback until the ad is right.

- Build a library of hooks, angles and winning ads, so the team can see what we learned.



After a year, success looks like this:

- New ad concepts go live every week, each with a clear brief and hypothesis.

- Every test has a result in the weekly report, and the next concepts are based on it.

- We have a set of winning ads per product and per market that we can scale.



What we ask

- At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at one or more comparable companies of the same size or bigger.

- At least 3 years as a creative strategist for paid social ads (Meta or TikTok), for e-commerce or consumer brands.

- You have written creative briefs for UGC creators, designers or video editors yourself.

- You use ad data (for example ROAS, CTR or hook rate) to d
 which ads to make next.

- In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

- This is your only job.

- Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

- At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

- A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience with ads for European markets.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about ad creative. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



What this job is not

- Not a graphic designer or video editor role. You plan and brief the ads, others make most of them.

- Not a media buyer role. You work closely with whoever runs the campaigns, but your focus is the creative.

- Not a graveyard shift.



How to apply

- A friendly, direct team with room to grow as the business grows.

You edit, then post by hand to TikTok, Instagram, Threads, YouTube, LinkedIn and X. This is a part-time role that moves to full time as volume grows.



What you will do



- Solo footage: cut silences, add punch-ins and captions (AutoCut Silences, AutoZoom, AutoCaptions)

- Multicam footage: run AutoPod or AutoCut Angles, then fix what the plugin gets wrong

- Non-talking-head videos, up to 2 a week, counted in the 14 videos a week: assemble from a script or voiceover with b-roll, stock footage and simple motion graphics

- Deliver 2 finished videos a day, 14 a week. Each needs a hook in the first 2 seconds, burned-in captions and clean audio

- Export a clean file for each platform's spec (9:16, 1:1, 16:9), with no watermarks from any app

- Post each video in its slot to all six platforms and log every post (link, time, platform) in a shared sheet



Three rules with no exceptions



1. No scheduling or automation tools. No Buffer, Hootsuite, Metricool, Later or anything like them. Every post goes up manually.

2. Captions and post text are typed by hand, never pasted. We supply the text. You type it.

3. You post through a remote session on our computer. You will never be given a password, and you must not ask for one.



Hours



25 hours a week. Editing hours are yours to arrange. Posting happens in two fixed daily slots, seven days a week, one video per slot, each posted to all six platforms:



- Morning: 8:00 to 9:00 am GMT+4 (12:00 to 1:00 pm Philippine time, GMT+8)

- Night: 8:00 to 9:00 pm GMT+4 (12:00 to 1:00 am Philippine time, GMT+8)



You can batch the editing ahead, but you cannot batch the posting.



You must already have



- 2+ years in Premiere Pro

- A portfolio with solo talking-head clips, multicam edits and at least one video with no one on camera

- Real project experience with AutoCut or AutoPod (we provide licences; we do not provide training)

- Basic motion graphics in Premiere or After Effects

- 50 wpm typing or better, with accurate English spelling and punctuation

- Your own machine with 16GB RAM minimum, a dedicated GPU, a 50 Mbps connection stable enough for remote-desktop work, and a backup connection



Do not apply if



- You edit only in CapCut or Canva

- You have never cut a multicam sequence

- You cannot commit to both daily posting slots

- You plan to subcontract the work



Pay



$300 to $350 per month, set by your paid test result. Paid twice a month. 13th month pay, pro-rated. Rate review at 3 months. When volume increases, the role goes full time at $450 to $600.



How to apply



Make MULTICAM the first word of your message. Then send, in this order:



1. Links to one solo talking-head clip, one multicam clip and one non-talking-head video, all cut by you

2. A 2-minute Loom screen recording of one of your Premiere projects with the AutoCut or AutoPod panel open, where you explain one cut the plugin got wrong and how you fixed it

3. Your computer specs and a speed test screenshot

4. How many hours your other jobs take

5. Your expected monthly rate



Shortlisted applicants first have a short Google Meet interview with us. After the interview, selected candidates get a paid test for $20: one raw solo file cut into a clip, and one 30-second video with no one on camera built from a script we supply.

title: Video Ads Maker with AI Tools | Facebook & Instagram
description:

One thing up front: we're not after a "cinematic" editor who cares only about nice-looking visuals. We want someone who gets how ads work.

▪ Show the product in a way that is clear and persuasive

▪ Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

▪ Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

▪ Guide viewers toward the click or the purchase



The starting point will be a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes. The end result should be a polished ad that is ready for testing. And when footage is missing, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.





TOOLS & EXPERIENCE

▪ HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

▪ ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

▪ Higgsfield: animated and generated video using nano banana pro, Kling, and Seedance

▪ At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

▪
/Meta ad creatives

▪ CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci, or similar tools

▪ Long-form video: VSLs or sales videos

▪ Captioning, overlays, motion graphics, sound design, b-roll, and pacing

SCHEDULE



Full-time, Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours. This is a remote contractor role.



PAY



$800 to $1,200 USD per month, depending on experience. Paid as an independent contractor. No employment benefits.

Apply through this OnlineJobs.ph posting. To show you read this post, type the word MAPLEWOOD on the first line of your application, then answer both questions below. Applications that omit the word or the answers will not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time QA Tester (Web + iPhone + Android) for Home Staging Software. Record Your Sessions
description:
StageEngine is software that runs home staging companies: their furniture inventory, jobs, proposals, contracts, invoices and payments. We're a small US company in California. We need a careful manual tester who enjoys trying to break things, every week, on a real iPhone, a real Android phone and a computer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Every week we put a new version of the app on our test site. Within 48 hours, work through that week's checklist (usually 30-80 checks) and mark each one pass, fail or blocked.

- Then use the app the way a staging company's office manager would (quote a job, send a contract, bill a client, check furniture in and out) and find where it breaks or where a real user would get stuck.

- Write clear bug reports: the steps, what you expected, what happened, the device, and the time in your recording.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 1 year of manual testing on web or mobile apps. SaaS is a plus; billing, invoicing or payment apps are a big plus.

- A working iPhone AND an Android phone of your own, plus a computer.

- Clear written English.

- You're comfortable recording your screen and talking through what you're doing. EVERY session is recorded, with your voice. This is required, and it's paid time.

- About 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday. Some overlap with US Pacific mornings (your late evening) is a plus.



PAY

- $550 a month base for about 20 hours a week.

- Plus a bonus for each confirmed bug that our own automated (AI) testing missed: $10 for a serious bug, $3 for a small one, up to $150 a month.

- Paid twice a month. It starts with a paid 2-hour trial on the real app.



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any of these are skipped)

1. Put the word SANDPIPER in the first line of your application.

2. Tell us which iPhone model and which Android phone you own.

3. Include a link to a 1-2 minute screen recording (Loom or Google Drive) of you testing the sign-up page of any website, talking through what you check and what you would report.
