title: Shopify Customer Support & Chargeback Specialist
description:
SHOPIFY CUSTOMER SUPPORT & CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST

FIRST EMPLOYEE | CAREER GROWTH | PERFORMANCE BONUSES | LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY



I am an ambitious e-commerce entrepreneur running multiple international Shopify stores, and I am looking for my very FIRST employee.



This is not just another Virtual Assistant job.



I am looking for someone who wants to become an important part of my business, grow alongside me, and potentially develop into a leadership or management position in the coming years.



As my first employee, you will have a unique opportunity to help build the foundation of my e-commerce business and become one of the most trusted and important members of my future team.



WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT?



- You will be my very first employee and work directly with me.

- You will have a key position in my business from day one.

- You can earn additional bonuses for successfully won chargeback disputes.

- You can earn performance-based bonuses for consistently excellent work.

- You will have opportunities for salary increases as you develop.

- You may grow into senior, team leader, or management positions.

- You will have the opportunity to help train and manage future employees.

- You will be involved in improving processes and building the business.

- I am looking for a long-term partnership, not a temporary employee.



My goal is to build a successful international e-commerce business over the next several years, and I want to find someone who is genuinely excited to be part of that journey.



I believe that people who contribute to the success of a business should also have opportunities to benefit from its growth.



I value honesty, reliability, initiative, hard work, and mutual respect.



----------------------------------------



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CUSTOMER SUPPORT



- Independently manage customer support for multiple Shopify stores.

- Respond professionally to customer
s.

- Handle tracking inquiries, shipping delays, returns, refunds, cancellations, and complaints.

- Communicate with suppliers when necessary.

- Follow my store policies and customer service guidelines.

- Assist customers in different languages using translation tools.

- Maintain fast response times and excellent customer satisfaction.

- Help improve customer support processes and overall efficiency.

- Take responsibility for providing consistent, high-quality customer service.



2. CHARGEBACKS AND PAYMENT DISPUTES



- Independently manage Shopify Payments chargebacks.

- Collect and organize tracking details, delivery confirmations, order information, and customer communications.

- Prepare accurate, professional, detailed, and convincing dispute responses.

- Submit evidence before all deadlines.

- Monitor open disputes and track results.

- Help prevent unnecessary chargebacks.

- Maintain organized records of disputes and outcomes.

- Provide regular reports on chargeback performance.

- Continuously improve dispute handling strategies.



IMPORTANT:



Chargeback management is a very important part of this position.



I am specifically looking for someone who already has experience handling Shopify Payments disputes and understands how to prepare strong evidence to maximize legitimate dispute success.



----------------------------------------



BONUSES AND PERFORMANCE REWARDS



In addition to your regular hourly salary, I want to reward employees who deliver excellent results.



1. CHARGEBACK WIN BONUSES



- Earn an additional bonus for eligible chargeback disputes successfully won.

- Bonuses will be based on verified dispute outcomes.

- The bonus structure will be explained and agreed upon before starting.

- Strong dispute management performance can lead to additional rewards.



2. PERFORMANCE-BASED BONUSES



Additional bonuses may be awarded for:



- Excellent customer support quality.

- Fast and accurate responses to customer inquiries.

- Consistently meeting agreed performance targets.

- Reliable and independent work.

- Improving customer satisfaction.

- Helping reduce preventable disputes.

- Improving workflows and overall efficiency.

- Taking initiative and solving problems independently.



3. SALARY GROWTH



- Opportunities for hourly salary increases based on performance.

- Additional compensation may be offered as responsibilities increase.

- Strong performers will be considered for future leadership opportunities.



I want to build a working relationship where excellent performance is recognized and rewarded.



----------------------------------------



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



- Minimum 1 year of hands-on Shopify customer support experience.

- Proven experience handling Shopify Payments chargebacks (REQUIRED).

- Experience managing multiple Shopify stores simultaneously.

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- A fast learner who can quickly understand new processes.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Honest, reliable, responsible, organized, and hardworking.

- Takes initiative instead of constantly waiting for instructions.

- Comfortable using e-commerce and customer service tools.

- Available to work on Saturdays and Sundays.

- Interested in growing professionally and taking on more responsibility.

- Looking for a stable, long-term position.



IMPORTANT:



I am NOT looking for a complete beginner.



I will personally explain my stores, policies, systems, and working methods during onboarding.



However, you must already have practical Shopify experience and be able to work independently after a short training period.



I am looking for someone who can take responsibility for their work and help make my daily operations easier.



----------------------------------------



WORKING HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Position: Full-Time / Long-Term

Working Hours: Approximately 30-40 hours per week

Saturday: Approximately 2-6 hours

Sunday: Approximately 2-6 hours

Schedule: Flexible, with agreed working hours and rest days

Training: Paid

Trial Period: Paid



ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION:



- Bonuses for eligible successfully won chargeback disputes.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for salary increases.

- Potential higher compensation with increased responsibilities.



Exact bonus arrangements will be discussed and agreed upon before employment begins.



----------------------------------------



YOUR FUTURE WITH MY BUSINESS



Because you will be my first employee, you will have a unique opportunity to grow alongside the business from the very beginning.



Initially, your main responsibilities will be customer support and chargeback management.



However, my goal is to expand my e-commerce business, hire additional employees, and build a strong international team over the coming years.



As the business grows, I want to give more responsibilities to people who have proven themselves to be trustworthy, capable, and motivated.



POTENTIAL FUTURE POSITIONS:



- Senior E-commerce Specialist

- Customer Support Team Leader

- Chargeback Management Lead

- E-commerce Operations Manager

- Team Manager



Depending on business growth and your performance, you may eventually become responsible for:



- Managing customer support across multiple stores.

- Training and supervising new employees.

- Leading the customer support team.

- Overseeing chargeback management.

- Improving daily e-commerce operations.

- Helping me organize and manage the business.

- Taking on important operational decisions within agreed responsibilities.



My intention is to build a team where dedicated employees have the opportunity to develop long-term careers.



I would love for my first employee to eventually become someone I can rely on to help lead the team.



These opportunities depend on business growth and individual performance, but I am serious about creating them.



----------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL the following questions:



1. How many years of Shopify customer support experience do you have?



2. Have you personally handled Shopify Payments chargebacks? Please describe your experience.



3. Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled, and what was your win rate?



4. Can you provide an anonymized example of a chargeback dispute you successfully handled?



5. Have you managed customer support for multiple Shopify stores simultaneously?



6. Which customer support tools and payment platforms have you used?



7. Are you available to work approximately 2-6 hours on both Saturdays and Sundays?



8. What is your expected hourly salary in USD, excluding performance bonuses?



9. When would you be available to start?



10. Would you be interested in growing into a leadership or management position in the future?



11. Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this long-term opportunity?



12. What would motivate you most in this position: career growth, performance bonuses, long-term stability, or a combination of these?



----------------------------------------



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Start your application with the word BLUEBIRD.



This helps me confirm that you have carefully read the entire job description.



Applications without this word or without answers to the questions may not be considered.



----------------------------------------



WHAT I OFFER



- A stable, long-term remote position.

- The opportunity to become my very first employee.

- An important role in a growing international e-commerce business.

- Direct communication and collaboration with the business owner.

- A friendly, respectful, and supportive working environment.

- Clear instructions and organized workflows.

- Paid onboarding and trial period.

- Flexible working arrangements.

- Bonuses for eligible successfully won chargeback disputes.

- Additional performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for salary increases.

- Potential growth into senior and management positions.

- The opportunity to help train and manage future employees.

- The chance to help build something successful from the beginning.



----------------------------------------



A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM ME



I want this position to be more than just a regular job.



I am looking for someone I can genuinely trust, someone who takes pride in their work, solves problems independently, and wants to achieve something meaningful together.



I am serious about growing my e-commerce business, and I believe that having the right people around me is one of the most important parts of that journey.



You do not need to know everything from day one.



What matters is that you already have a strong foundation, learn quickly, take responsibility, and genuinely care about delivering excellent work.



I want to create a professional relationship based on honesty, trust, respect, ambition, and long-term commitment.



I also believe that great work should be rewarded.



That is why I want to offer opportunities for performance bonuses, salary growth, and future promotions as the business expands.



My goal is that several years from now, we can look back and be proud of what we have built together.



I am not just looking for someone to work FOR me.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow WITH me.



If you are experienced, motivated, reliable, and excited about becoming the first member of a growing e-commerce business, I would genuinely love to hear from you.



I look forward to meeting you!

title: Chargeback Operations Specialist
description:
We’re hiring: Chargeback Operations Specialist at Disputely 



Disputely stops chargebacks before they happen. E-commerce merchants install our app, and we protect them with automated pre-dispute alerts across Visa (RDR + CDRN) and Mastercard (Ethoca), plus chargeback fighting and dispute resolution. Merchants do almost nothing. Our team runs everything behind it.I lead Platform, Customer Support and Success. I’m looking for an A-player who already knows chargebacks inside out and wants to own operations from day one. This is not a role where we teach you what an ARN is.



What you’ll own🔹 Enrolling new merchants in Visa and Mastercard alert programs and making sure they’re actually covered: the right descriptors, BINs, CAIDs and MIDs🔹 Running the support inbox across
, live chat and Slack, and resolving merchant questions quickly and correctly the first time🔹 Investigating alerts that didn’t match, coverage gaps and declined enrollments until the root cause is found and fixed🔹 Moving merchants over from other chargeback providers with zero gaps in protection🔹 Writing clearly to merchants, partners, Visa, Mastercard and our founders🔹 Turning the problems you keep seeing into SOPs and product feedback, so they don’t come back



What we require✅ 4+ years in customer support, handling high ticket volumes across
, live chat and Slack✅ Advanced chargeback knowledge: dispute lifecycles, reason codes, how pre-dispute alerts differ from chargebacks, representment, chargeback ratios and monitoring programs (VAMP, ECM/EFM)✅ Hands-on experience with Visa or Mastercard dispute programs. Verifi (RDR, CDRN) or Ethoca is strongly preferred✅ You understand the payments chain: acquirers, processors, BINs, CAIDs, MIDs, ARNs and billing descriptors, and how they connect✅ You’ve run a merchant migration between chargeback or payment providers, or a similar provider-to-provider handover✅ Excellent written and spoken English. Every message you write reaches merchants, card networks or our founders✅ Detail-obsessed. You own problems until they’re closed, and nobody has to chase you



Nice to have➕ Experience at a chargeback provider, payment processor, acquirer or high-risk merchant➕ Familiar with Shopify, Stripe, Adyen or 
, and with Pylon or a similar help desk➕ Fluent in Spanish

Why join💡 A small team, working directly with the founders, where your work is visible📈 A fast-growing payments product with real traction🛠️ Real ownership: you’ll shape how our operations run, not just follow a playbook🌍 Fully remote💰 Competitive pay, based on experience



How to apply



Apply through this form 👉







As part of your application, record a short video (2 minutes max) where you:1️⃣ Introduce yourself and your chargeback experience2️⃣ Answer this question: “A merchant is enrolled in RDR but a Visa dispute still became a chargeback. What are the first three things you’d check?”⚠️ Applications without a video won’t be considered.

title: Experienced UK Practice Accountant
description:
Experienced UK Practice Accountant | Remote | $10/hour



Pay: $10 USD per hour

Hours: 20 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to progress to full-time

Location: Remote 

Start: ASAP



About Us



LDM Accounting Services Ltd is a growing UK-based accountancy practice providing bookkeeping, VAT, statutory accounts, Corporation Tax and advisory services to small businesses across the UK.



We're looking for an experienced accountant to join our team remotely from the Philippines. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who can work independently, take ownership of client work and help improve our internal systems and processes as the business grows.



Key Responsibilities



• Bookkeeping: Managing bookkeeping, reconciliations and journals for UK businesses using Xero.

• VAT: Independently preparing UK VAT returns, including different VAT schemes and reverse charges.

• Statutory Accounts: Preparing UK limited company accounts, including year-end adjustments and supporting working papers.

• Corporation Tax: Preparing Corporation Tax computations and CT600 returns, including relevant tax adjustments.

• Systems & Processes: Helping improve internal workflows, checklists, procedures and practice management systems.

• Practice Support: Preparing client queries, organising records and assisting with other accounting and administrative tasks.



Essential Requirements



Please only apply if you meet ALL of the following:



• Minimum 5 years' experience working with UK accounting clients, ideally within an accountancy practice.

• Proven experience independently preparing UK bookkeeping, VAT returns, limited company statutory accounts and Corporation Tax computations/CT600s.

• Strong practical experience using Xero.

• Experience using UK accounts production and Corporation Tax software.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Ability to work accurately and independently with minimal supervision.

• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a proactive approach.



Experience with Xero Tax, TaxCalc, UK payroll, CIS or improving accounting systems would be advantageous.



Working Arrangements



• $10 USD per hour.

• 20 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to increase to 40 hours.

• Flexible working schedule across 3–5 days, with some overlap with UK working hours.

• Fully remote, long-term opportunity.



How to Apply



Applications must include a CV, answers to ALL the questions below and a 1–2 minute video introduction in English. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Screening Questions



1. How many years have you worked with UK accounting clients, and what types of businesses have you worked with?

2. Describe your experience independently preparing UK bookkeeping and VAT returns, including the VAT schemes you've worked with.

3. Have you independently prepared UK limited company statutory accounts? Which software have you used?

4. Have you independently prepared Corporation Tax computations and CT600 returns? Which software have you used?

5. How many years have you used Xero, and what other UK accounting or tax software are you experienced with?

6. Have you helped improve accounting systems, workflows or internal processes? Please provide an example.

7. Are you confident completing bookkeeping, VAT, accounts and Corporation Tax work independently with minimal supervision?

8. Can you commit to 20 hours per week at $10/hour, with the potential to increase to full-time?



Video Introduction (Required)



Please submit a 1–2 minute video in English introducing yourself, summarising your UK accounting experience, the software you've used and why you're suitable for the role.



A simple phone or computer recording is fine.



Selection Process



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a Microsoft Teams interview involving technical questions on UK bookkeeping, VAT, statutory accounts and Corporation Tax. 



We're looking for someone who can contribute from day one, work independently and become a valued long-term member of our growing team.
